title: TestPrism: Rethinking Test Evaluation Beyond a Single Reference
title_zh: TestPrism：超越单一参考方案，重新思考测试评估

paragraphs.en: short-title=TestPrism: Rethinking Test Evaluation Beyond a Single Reference 1]Nanjing University 2]Hong Kong Polytechnic University 3]Tencent \contribution [*]Equal contribution. \contribution [†]Corresponding author.
paragraphs.zh: 短标题=TestPrism：超越单一参考的测试评估再思考 1]南京大学 2]香港理工大学 3]腾讯 \contribution [*]同等贡献。 \contribution [†]通讯作者。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents have advanced test generation across diverse programming tasks. However, the common practice of evaluating tests against a single reference solution overlooks alternative valid implementations and can overstate test quality. We introduce TestPrism , comprising 300 test tasks from 17 sources and 3000 candidate implementations, evenly split between valid and invalid solutions. Its primary metric, Joint Success Function , requires the generated tests to fail on the initial program state, accept every valid candidate, and reject every invalid candidate. Across fourteen baseline coding agent configurations, Joint Success Function reaches only 28.00%, whereas single reference success reaches 59.67%. Our analysis reveals missed behaviors, unsupported assertions, and faulty test construction. To address these weaknesses, we introduce TestHelix , which combines heterogeneous synthesis of test and repair pairs with peer cross validation and recursive self improvement (RSI). Across two models, TestHelix improves Joint Success Function by 8.67 to 9.00 percentage points over the native harness comparators in the TestHelix evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）编码智能体已在多样化的编程任务中实现了测试生成能力的提升。 然而，将测试与单一参考解决方案进行比较的常见评估方法，忽视了其他有效的实现方式，并可能高估测试质量。 我们提出了 TestPrism，它包含来自 17 个来源的 300 项测试任务以及 3000 个候选实现，这些实现被均匀地划分为有效和无效解决方案。 其主要指标——联合成功函数——要求生成的测试在初始程序状态下失败，接受所有有效候选方案，并拒绝所有无效候选方案。 在十四种基础编码智能体配置中，联合成功函数仅达到 28.00%，而单一参考成功率为 59.67%。 我们的分析揭示了被忽略的行为、未得到支持的断言以及错误的测试构建问题。 为了解决这些弱点，我们提出了 TestHelix，它将测试与修复对的异构合成与同伴交叉验证及递归自我改进（RSI）相结合。 在两种模型中，TestHelix 的联合成功函数相较于 TestHelix 评估中的原生测试框架比较器提升了 8.67 至 9.00 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents, such as Codex and Claude Code, can navigate repositories, modify implementations, and validate changes through execution feedback ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . These capabilities also support automated test generation and improvement ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Alshahwan et al., 2024 ) . Reliable tests must generalize across valid implementations while remaining sensitive to specification violations ( Zhu et al., 1997 ; Barr et al., 2015 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）编码智能体，如 Codex 和 Claude Code，能够浏览代码库、修改实现，并通过执行反馈验证变更（Yang 等，2024a；Wang 等，2024；Wang 等，2025b；Pan 等，2026；Li 等，2026b）。 这些能力还支持自动化的测试生成与改进（Chen 等，2024；Alshahwan 等，2024）。 可靠的测试必须能在有效实现中保持通用性，同时仍能敏锐地检测出对规格的违反（Zhu 等，1997；Barr 等，2015）。

paragraphs.en: Test generation benchmarks span function level tasks, as in TestEval ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and repository issues, as in SWT Bench ( Mündler et al., 2025 ) . A common success criterion remains single reference evaluation : a suite must fail on the initial program and pass on one gold solution ( Mündler et al., 2025 ; Ahmed et al., 2024 ) . Yet a requirement can admit multiple valid implementations and plausible incorrect ones. A test can pass this check while missing required behavior ( Qi et al., 2015 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) or imposing unnecessary implementation constraints. We therefore ask: How robust is the evaluation of generated tests to variation across implementations? Table 1 compares existing benchmarks; counting conventions and target mappings appear in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 测试生成基准涵盖函数级任务（如 TestEval (Wang et al., 2025a)）以及仓库问题（如 SWT Bench (Mündler et al., 2025)）。 一个常见的成功标准仍然是单参考评估：测试套件必须对初始程序失败，但对一个黄金解决方案成功（Mündler et al., 2025；Ahmed et al., 2024）。 然而，一个要求可能允许多种有效的实现以及多种看似合理但错误的实现。 一项测试可能在未满足所需行为（Qi et al., 2015；Liu et al., 2023）或施加不必要的实现约束的情况下通过此检查。 因此我们提出一个问题：生成的测试在评估上对实现差异的鲁棒性如何？ 表 1 比较了现有的基准；计数惯例和目标映射见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: TestPrism contains 300 test tasks from 17 sources across six programming languages, covering repository maintenance, algorithmic programming, and performance optimization. We adapt executable tasks to a shared interface, enrich their candidate patch sets, verify and select diverse implementations, and convert the tasks for test generation. For each test task, we retain the reference and select four valid alternatives and five invalid implementations through explicit diversity checks. Building on this pipeline, we construct TestPrism with 2,000 tasks from 17 source benchmarks, partitioned into 1,700 training tasks and 300 test tasks. The test set contains 3000 candidate implementations and spans six task categories and 34 subcategories across 67 repositories and projects. This task diversity supports assessing how well coding agents generalize test generation across programming scenarios. The disjoint training set supports adapting test generation strategies in TestHelix’s recursive self improvement (RSI) stage.
paragraphs.zh: TestPrism 包含来自 17 个来源、涵盖六种编程语言的 300 项测试任务，涉及仓库维护、算法编程和性能优化。 我们将可执行的任务适配到统一接口，丰富其候选补丁集，验证并选择多样化的实现方案，然后将这些任务转换为测试生成格式。 对于每项测试任务，我们保留参考实现，并通过显式多样性检查选出四个有效替代方案和五个无效实现。 基于这一流程，我们构建了 TestPrism，其中包含来自 17 个源基准的 2000 项任务，分为 1700 项训练任务和 300 项测试任务。 测试集包含 3000 个候选实现，覆盖六个任务类别和 34 个子类别，涉及 67 个仓库和项目。 这种任务多样性有助于评估编码智能体在不同编程场景下生成测试的能力泛化性。 独立的训练集支持在 TestHelix 的递归自我改进（RSI）阶段调整测试生成策略。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation protocol executes each submitted suite on the initial state and every candidate. Its primary metric, Joint Success Function , requires initial failure and agreement with every candidate label. Restricting the panel to the reference recovers single reference evaluation as a minimal approximation. Complementary acceptance, rejection, and coverage metrics locate behavioral disagreements and the code exercised by the tests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估协议会在初始状态和每个候选智能体上执行每一套提交的测试套件。 其主要指标——联合成功函数——要求初始状态失败，并且与每个候选智能体的标签一致。 将评审组限制在参考智能体上，可恢复为单参考评估，作为最小近似方案。 补充的接受、拒绝和覆盖指标能够定位行为差异以及测试所执行的代码。

paragraphs.en: We introduce TestHelix to address these weaknesses through heterogeneous synthesis of test and repair pairs. Its inner workflow establishes consistency within each pair, then uses peer cross validation, comprising cross execution, semantic review, and corrective feedback, to check and correct tests across pairs. Its outer RSI loop proposes test generation strategies on training tasks and validates one frozen challenger on a disjoint set before benchmark evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入 TestHelix，通过测试与修复对的异构合成来解决这些弱点。 其内部工作流程首先确保每对内部的连贯性，然后利用同伴交叉验证（包括交叉执行、语义审查和纠正反馈）来检查并修正不同测试对之间的测试。 其外部的 RSI 循环会在训练任务上提出测试生成策略，并在基准评估前于一个不相交的数据集上验证一个已固定的挑战者。

sents.zh: 其外部的 RSI 循环会在训练任务上提出测试生成策略，并在基准评估前于一个不相交的数据集上验证一个已固定的挑战者。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate fourteen coding agent configurations spanning six model families. Our analysis reveals four key findings: ❶ Reliable test generation remains far from solved by frontier models. The strongest baseline reaches only 28.00% Joint Success Function, compared with 59.67% single reference success (Table 2 ). Coverage tracks success: change and entry coverage correlate with Joint Success Function across configurations ( r = 0.91 r=0.91 and 0.96 0.96 ). ❷ Joint Success Function is a dynamic measure of reliability across implementations. Larger candidate panels impose additional behavioral requirements, as shown in Figure 3 . Single reference evaluation is its weakest special case and an upper bound on expanded panel success. ❸ Failures span coverage gaps, faulty checks, and execution logic errors. We sample 300 failed trajectories, 50 from the highest Joint Success Function configuration in each of six model families, and analyze 286 after excluding 14 timeout trajectories. The category shares among the analyzed trajectories are 34.6%, 50.0%, and 15.4%, respectively (Figure 4 ), explaining limited reliability through omissions, misjudgments, and execution failures. Missing inputs and weak assertions can pass single reference evaluation while accepting invalid patches. ❹ Heterogeneous synthesis helps tests generalize across implementations. With peer cross validation using diverse repairs to check and correct tests and RSI adapting test generation strategies across tasks, TestHelix raises Joint Success Function over Single by 11.67 to 12.00 percentage points under matched inference budget caps (Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了涵盖六个模型系列的十四种编码智能体配置。 我们的分析揭示了四个关键发现：❶ 前沿模型在可靠的测试生成方面仍远未解决。 最强的基线模型仅达到 28.00% 的联合成功函数，而单一参考成功率为 59.67%（表 2）。 覆盖度与成功率相关：在所有配置中，变更和入口覆盖度均与联合成功函数呈正相关（r = 0.91 和 0.96）。❷ 联合成功函数是衡量不同实现可靠性的动态指标。 更大的候选集会带来额外的行为要求，如图 3 所示。 单一参考评估是其最弱的特例，也是扩展面板成功率的上限。❸ 失败原因包括覆盖漏洞、检查错误以及执行逻辑错误。 我们从每个模型系列中选取联合成功函数最高的配置，各抽取 50 条失败轨迹，共采样 300 条；排除 14 条超时轨迹后，对 286 条进行了分析。 所分析轨迹的类别重合率分别为 34.6%、50.0% 和 15.4%（图 4），这解释了因遗漏、误判和执行失败导致的可靠性有限问题。 输入缺失和断言薄弱可能导致单一参考评估通过，但实际却接受了无效的补丁。❹ 异构合成有助于测试在不同实现中实现泛化。 通过同伴交叉验证——利用多样化的修复方案来检查与修正测试，以及 RSI 跨任务自适应测试生成策略——TestHelix 在匹配推理预算限制下，使联合成功函数较单一参考提升了 11.67 至 12.00 个百分点（表 3）。

sents.en: We evaluate fourteen coding agent configurations spanning six model families.
sents.zh: 我们评估了涵盖六个模型系列的十四种编码智能体配置。

sents.en: Our analysis reveals four key findings: ❶ Reliable test generation remains far from solved by frontier models.
sents.zh: 我们的分析揭示了四个关键发现：❶ 前沿模型在可靠的测试生成方面仍远未解决。

sents.en: The strongest baseline reaches only 28.00% Joint Success Function, compared with 59.67% single reference success (Table 2 ).
sents.zh: 最强的基线模型仅达到 28.00% 的联合成功函数，而单一参考成功率为 59.67%（表 2）。

sents.en: Coverage tracks success: change and entry coverage correlate with Joint Success Function across configurations ( r = 0.91 r=0.91 and 0.96 0.96 ). ❷ Joint Success Function is a dynamic measure of reliability across implementations.
sents.zh: 覆盖度与成功率相关：在所有配置中，变更和入口覆盖度均与联合成功函数呈正相关（r = 0.91 和 0.96）。❷ 联合成功函数是衡量不同实现可靠性的动态指标。

sents.en: Larger candidate panels impose additional behavioral requirements, as shown in Figure 3 .
sents.zh: 更大的候选集会带来额外的行为要求，如图 3 所示。

sents.en: Single reference evaluation is its weakest special case and an upper bound on expanded panel success. ❸ Failures span coverage gaps, faulty checks, and execution logic errors.
sents.zh: 单一参考评估是其最弱的特例，也是扩展面板成功率的上限。❸ 失败原因包括覆盖漏洞、检查错误以及执行逻辑错误。

sents.en: We sample 300 failed trajectories, 50 from the highest Joint Success Function configuration in each of six model families, and analyze 286 after excluding 14 timeout trajectories.
sents.zh: 我们从每个模型系列中选取联合成功函数最高的配置，各抽取 50 条失败轨迹，共采样 300 条；排除 14 条超时轨迹后，对 286 条进行了分析。

sents.en: The category shares among the analyzed trajectories are 34.6%, 50.0%, and 15.4%, respectively (Figure 4 ), explaining limited reliability through omissions, misjudgments, and execution failures.
sents.zh: 所分析轨迹的类别重合率分别为 34.6%、50.0% 和 15.4%（图 4），这解释了因遗漏、误判和执行失败导致的可靠性有限问题。

sents.en: Missing inputs and weak assertions can pass single reference evaluation while accepting invalid patches. ❹ Heterogeneous synthesis helps tests generalize across implementations.
sents.zh: 输入缺失和断言薄弱可能导致单一参考评估通过，但实际却接受了无效的补丁。❹ 异构合成有助于测试在不同实现中实现泛化。

sents.en: With peer cross validation using diverse repairs to check and correct tests and RSI adapting test generation strategies across tasks, TestHelix raises Joint Success Function over Single by 11.67 to 12.00 percentage points under matched inference budget caps (Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 通过同伴交叉验证——利用多样化的修复方案来检查与修正测试，以及 RSI 跨任务自适应测试生成策略——TestHelix 在匹配推理预算限制下，使联合成功函数较单一参考提升了 11.67 至 12.00 个百分点（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: We construct TestPrism , with 1,700 training tasks and 300 test tasks from 17 sources, providing 3000 labeled implementations for evaluation. Its Joint Success Function criterion extends single reference evaluation to assess whether generated tests accept valid alternatives and reject incorrect implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 TestPrism，它包含来自 17 个来源的 1,700 个训练任务和 300 个测试任务，并为评估提供了 3000 个带标签的实现。 其联合成功函数标准将单一参考评估扩展为评估生成的测试是否能够接受有效替代方案并拒绝错误实现。

sents.en: We construct TestPrism , with 1,700 training tasks and 300 test tasks from 17 sources, providing 3000 labeled implementations for evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们构建了 TestPrism，它包含来自 17 个来源的 1,700 个训练任务和 300 个测试任务，并为评估提供了 3000 个带标签的实现。

sents.en: Its Joint Success Function criterion extends single reference evaluation to assess whether generated tests accept valid alternatives and reject incorrect implementations.
sents.zh: 其联合成功函数标准将单一参考评估扩展为评估生成的测试是否能够接受有效替代方案并拒绝错误实现。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate fourteen coding agent configurations across six model families and develop an error taxonomy from 286 retained failed trajectories spanning their highest Joint Success Function configurations. These complementary analyses characterize current agent performance and identify specific mistakes that cause generated tests to miss invalid behavior or reject valid alternatives, including failures hidden by single reference evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在六个模型系列中评估了十四种编码智能体配置，并从涵盖其最高联合成功函数配置在内的 286 条保留的失败轨迹中构建了一个错误分类体系。 这些互补性分析描述了当前智能体的性能，并识别出导致生成测试未能检测到无效行为或拒绝有效替代方案的具体错误，包括被单一参考评估所掩盖的失败情况。

sents.en: We evaluate fourteen coding agent configurations across six model families and develop an error taxonomy from 286 retained failed trajectories spanning their highest Joint Success Function configurations.
sents.zh: 我们在六个模型系列中评估了十四种编码智能体配置，并从涵盖其最高联合成功函数配置在内的 286 条保留的失败轨迹中构建了一个错误分类体系。

sents.en: These complementary analyses characterize current agent performance and identify specific mistakes that cause generated tests to miss invalid behavior or reject valid alternatives, including failures hidden by single reference evaluation.
sents.zh: 这些互补性分析描述了当前智能体的性能，并识别出导致生成测试未能检测到无效行为或拒绝有效替代方案的具体错误，包括被单一参考评估所掩盖的失败情况。

paragraphs.en: We introduce TestHelix , which combines heterogeneous synthesis with peer cross validation and RSI. It checks and corrects tests through cross execution and semantic review, and adapts reusable test generation strategies to improve reliability across implementations under matched inference budget caps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 TestHelix，它将异构合成与同行交叉验证和 RSI 相结合。 它通过交叉执行和语义审查来检查并纠正测试，同时调整可重用的测试生成策略，以在匹配的推理预算限制下提升不同实现之间的可靠性。

sents.en: We introduce TestHelix , which combines heterogeneous synthesis with peer cross validation and RSI.
sents.zh: 我们提出 TestHelix，它将异构合成与同行交叉验证和 RSI 相结合。

sents.en: It checks and corrects tests through cross execution and semantic review, and adapts reusable test generation strategies to improve reliability across implementations under matched inference budget caps.
sents.zh: 它通过交叉执行和语义审查来检查并纠正测试，同时调整可重用的测试生成策略，以在匹配的推理预算限制下提升不同实现之间的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether generated tests generalize beyond a single reference, we construct TestPrism through four steps: (i) task screening and adaptation , (ii) task selection , (iii) patch generation and validation , and (iv) diversity filtering and task conversion . Each test instance pairs a test generation task with a curated panel of valid and invalid implementations. Figure 1 outlines the pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估生成的测试能否超越单个参考用例实现泛化，我们通过四个步骤构建 TestPrism：(i) 任务筛选与适配，(ii) 任务选择，(iii) 补丁生成与验证，以及 (iv) 多样性过滤与任务转换。 每个测试实例都将一个测试生成任务与一组经过精心挑选的有效和无效实现方案进行配对。 图 1 概述了该流程。

sents.en: To evaluate whether generated tests generalize beyond a single reference, we construct TestPrism through four steps: (i) task screening and adaptation , (ii) task selection , (iii) patch generation and validation , and (iv) diversity filtering and task conversion .
sents.zh: 为了评估生成的测试能否超越单个参考用例实现泛化，我们通过四个步骤构建 TestPrism：(i) 任务筛选与适配，(ii) 任务选择，(iii) 补丁生成与验证，以及 (iv) 多样性过滤与任务转换。

sents.en: Each test instance pairs a test generation task with a curated panel of valid and invalid implementations.
sents.zh: 每个测试实例都将一个测试生成任务与一组经过精心挑选的有效和无效实现方案进行配对。

sents.en: Figure 1 outlines the pipeline.
sents.zh: 图 1 概述了该流程。

paragraphs.en: We curate tasks from 17 public benchmarks, including the widely used SWE bench and Terminal Bench families ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) , requiring traceable test provenance and documented validation (Appendix B.3.1 ). We retain coding tasks whose requirements can be checked with executable tests, excluding unusable Docker images and irreproducible environments. Adapters map tasks to Harbor’s instruction, environment, tests, and solution components while preserving requirements, initial states, verifiers, reference solutions, dependencies, services, and execution limits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 17 个公开基准中筛选任务，包括广泛使用的 SWE bench 和 Terminal Bench 系列（Jimenez 等，2024；Merrill 等，2026），这些任务要求测试来源可追溯且验证过程有文档记录（附录 B.3.1）。 我们保留那些需求可通过可执行测试进行验证的编码任务，同时排除无法使用的 Docker 镜像和不可复现的环境。 适配器将任务映射到 Harbor 的指令、环境、测试和解决方案组件，同时保留需求、初始状态、验证器、参考解决方案、依赖项、服务和执行限制。

sents.en: We curate tasks from 17 public benchmarks, including the widely used SWE bench and Terminal Bench families ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) , requiring traceable test provenance and documented validation (Appendix B.3.1 ).
sents.zh: 我们从 17 个公开基准中筛选任务，包括广泛使用的 SWE bench 和 Terminal Bench 系列（Jimenez 等，2024；Merrill 等，2026），这些任务要求测试来源可追溯且验证过程有文档记录（附录 B.3.1）。

sents.en: We retain coding tasks whose requirements can be checked with executable tests, excluding unusable Docker images and irreproducible environments.
sents.zh: 我们保留那些需求可通过可执行测试进行验证的编码任务，同时排除无法使用的 Docker 镜像和不可复现的环境。

sents.en: Adapters map tasks to Harbor’s instruction, environment, tests, and solution components while preserving requirements, initial states, verifiers, reference solutions, dependencies, services, and execution limits.
sents.zh: 适配器将任务映射到 Harbor 的指令、环境、测试和解决方案组件，同时保留需求、初始状态、验证器、参考解决方案、依赖项、服务和执行限制。

paragraphs.en: We screen tasks using Solution Size , the effective lines of solution.sh ; Test Count , the enumerated test functions or metadata checks; and Test Density , this count per file changed by the reference solution. Lower bounds are calibrated to each source’s own distribution, and source quotas balance representation across the disjoint training and candidate test sets. Appendix B.2 reports the source-specific screening thresholds. We retain 1,700 training tasks for TestHelix’s recursive self improvement (RSI); only candidate test tasks undergo the remaining patch generation and filtering steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用“解决方案规模”（即 solution.sh 中的有效代码行数）、“测试数量”（即枚举的测试函数或元数据检查）以及“测试密度”（即参考解决方案中每个被修改文件的测试数量）来筛选任务。 下限根据每个数据源自身的分布进行校准，而数据源配额则用于平衡互不重叠的训练集和候选测试集之间的代表性。 附录 B.2 报告了各数据源特定的筛选阈值。 我们为 TestHelix 的递归自我改进（RSI）保留了 1,700 个训练任务；只有候选测试任务会经过剩余的补丁生成和过滤步骤。

sents.en: We screen tasks using Solution Size , the effective lines of solution.sh ; Test Count , the enumerated test functions or metadata checks; and Test Density , this count per file changed by the reference solution.
sents.zh: 我们使用“解决方案规模”（即 solution.sh 中的有效代码行数）、“测试数量”（即枚举的测试函数或元数据检查）以及“测试密度”（即参考解决方案中每个被修改文件的测试数量）来筛选任务。

sents.en: Lower bounds are calibrated to each source’s own distribution, and source quotas balance representation across the disjoint training and candidate test sets.
sents.zh: 下限根据每个数据源自身的分布进行校准，而数据源配额则用于平衡互不重叠的训练集和候选测试集之间的代表性。

sents.en: Appendix B.2 reports the source-specific screening thresholds.
sents.zh: 附录 B.2 报告了各数据源特定的筛选阈值。

sents.en: We retain 1,700 training tasks for TestHelix’s recursive self improvement (RSI); only candidate test tasks undergo the remaining patch generation and filtering steps.
sents.zh: 我们为 TestHelix 的递归自我改进（RSI）保留了 1,700 个训练任务；只有候选测试任务会经过剩余的补丁生成和过滤步骤。

paragraphs.en: Verifier validation. All source benchmarks provide test suites validated through execution checks, expert review, or official competition evaluation. Our additional validation round checks each adapted verifier before candidate generation, requiring failure on the initial state and success on the reference solution. Two experts use development experience to independently assess task requirements and source verifiers for potential overfitting and coverage gaps. Discussion clarifies disagreements; tasks with unresolved concerns are excluded. Independent verifier usability judgments achieve Cohen’s κ = 0.68 \kappa=0.68 . Appendix B.3.1 documents the prior validation evidence and our additional review.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器验证。 所有源基准测试均提供通过执行检查、专家审查或官方竞赛评估验证的测试套件。 我们的额外验证环节在生成候选方案前，会对每个经过适配的验证器进行检查，要求其在初始状态下失败，并在参考解决方案上成功。 两位专家基于开发经验，独立评估任务需求及源验证器是否存在潜在过拟合和覆盖范围缺失的问题。 讨论环节会澄清分歧；存在未解决疑虑的任务将被排除。 独立验证器可用性判断的 Cohen’s κ 值为 0.68 \kappa=0.68 。 附录 B.3.1 记录了先前的验证证据以及我们的额外审查内容。

sents.en: Verifier validation.
sents.zh: 验证器验证。

sents.en: All source benchmarks provide test suites validated through execution checks, expert review, or official competition evaluation.
sents.zh: 所有源基准测试均提供通过执行检查、专家审查或官方竞赛评估验证的测试套件。

sents.en: Our additional validation round checks each adapted verifier before candidate generation, requiring failure on the initial state and success on the reference solution.
sents.zh: 我们的额外验证环节在生成候选方案前，会对每个经过适配的验证器进行检查，要求其在初始状态下失败，并在参考解决方案上成功。

sents.en: Two experts use development experience to independently assess task requirements and source verifiers for potential overfitting and coverage gaps.
sents.zh: 两位专家基于开发经验，独立评估任务需求及源验证器是否存在潜在过拟合和覆盖范围缺失的问题。

sents.en: Discussion clarifies disagreements; tasks with unresolved concerns are excluded.
sents.zh: 讨论环节会澄清分歧；存在未解决疑虑的任务将被排除。

sents.en: Independent verifier usability judgments achieve Cohen’s κ = 0.68 \kappa=0.68 .
sents.zh: 独立验证器可用性判断的 Cohen’s κ 值为 0.68 \kappa=0.68 。

sents.en: Appendix B.3.1 documents the prior validation evidence and our additional review.
sents.zh: 附录 B.3.1 记录了先前的验证证据以及我们的额外审查内容。

paragraphs.en: Patch generation. We generate candidate patches with different coding agents and models of varying capabilities to capture alternative solutions and errors arising during task solving, complementing mutation based fault models ( Just et al., 2014 ; Jia & Harman, 2011 ) . We remove empty submissions, exact duplicates, and inapplicable patches, then execute the source verifier in clean environments and record outcomes for individual checks. A candidate is valid if every check passes and invalid if any check fails. These labels remain fixed when evaluating generated tests.
paragraphs.zh: 补丁生成。 我们使用不同能力和模型的各种编码智能体生成候选补丁，以捕捉任务解决过程中出现的替代解决方案和错误，从而补充基于突变的故障模型（Just 等，2014；Jia & Harman，2011）。 我们移除空提交、完全重复的提交以及不适用补丁，然后在干净的环境中执行源验证器，并记录各项检查的结果。 如果所有检查都通过，则候选项有效；如果任何一项检查失败，则无效。 在评估生成的测试时，这些标签保持固定不变。

sents.en: Patch generation.
sents.zh: 补丁生成。

sents.en: We generate candidate patches with different coding agents and models of varying capabilities to capture alternative solutions and errors arising during task solving, complementing mutation based fault models ( Just et al., 2014 ; Jia & Harman, 2011 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用不同能力和模型的各种编码智能体生成候选补丁，以捕捉任务解决过程中出现的替代解决方案和错误，从而补充基于突变的故障模型（Just 等，2014；Jia & Harman，2011）。

sents.en: We remove empty submissions, exact duplicates, and inapplicable patches, then execute the source verifier in clean environments and record outcomes for individual checks.
sents.zh: 我们移除空提交、完全重复的提交以及不适用补丁，然后在干净的环境中执行源验证器，并记录各项检查的结果。

sents.en: A candidate is valid if every check passes and invalid if any check fails.
sents.zh: 如果所有检查都通过，则候选项有效；如果任何一项检查失败，则无效。

sents.en: These labels remain fixed when evaluating generated tests.
sents.zh: 在评估生成的测试时，这些标签保持固定不变。

paragraphs.en: We assemble panels of one reference, four valid alternatives, and five invalid implementations. The valid group must meet the mean AST distance criterion. For invalid implementations, different sets of failed verifier checks pass the diversity check directly; matching sets require the AST Jaccard check. We refine panels through generation and replacement until both group criteria hold, then apply source quotas in final sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建面板，每个面板包含一个参考样本、四个有效替代方案以及五个无效实现。 有效组必须满足平均 AST 距离标准。 对于无效实现，不同的验证器检查失败集合会直接通过多样性检查；而匹配集合则需要通过 AST Jaccard 检查。 我们通过生成和替换来优化面板，直到两个组别标准均满足，然后在最终采样中应用源配额。

sents.en: We assemble panels of one reference, four valid alternatives, and five invalid implementations.
sents.zh: 我们构建面板，每个面板包含一个参考样本、四个有效替代方案以及五个无效实现。

sents.en: The valid group must meet the mean AST distance criterion.
sents.zh: 有效组必须满足平均 AST 距离标准。

sents.en: For invalid implementations, different sets of failed verifier checks pass the diversity check directly; matching sets require the AST Jaccard check.
sents.zh: 对于无效实现，不同的验证器检查失败集合会直接通过多样性检查；而匹配集合则需要通过 AST Jaccard 检查。

sents.en: We refine panels through generation and replacement until both group criteria hold, then apply source quotas in final sampling.
sents.zh: 我们通过生成和替换来优化面板，直到两个组别标准均满足，然后在最终采样中应用源配额。

paragraphs.en: The test generation adapter converts each programming task into a test authoring contract: submit tests, fixtures, and one executable entry script in a designated artifact directory. The original requirement defines the behavior to test; the candidate panel remains hidden during test generation. Appendix B.4 gives the filtering stages and implementation details.
paragraphs.zh: 测试生成适配器将每个编程任务转换为一个测试编写合同：在指定的工件目录中提交测试、测试用例和一条可执行的入口脚本。 原始需求定义了需要测试的行为；在测试生成期间，候选面板保持隐藏状态。 附录 B.4 介绍了过滤阶段和实现细节。

sents.en: The test generation adapter converts each programming task into a test authoring contract: submit tests, fixtures, and one executable entry script in a designated artifact directory.

paragraphs.en: TestPrism contains 2,000 tasks collected and adapted from 17 source benchmarks, with 1,700 tasks in the training set and 300 in the test set. The partitions are disjoint. The test set contains 3000 labeled implementations across six programming languages and 67 repositories and projects.
paragraphs.zh: TestPrism 包含从 17 个源基准测试中收集并调整而来的 2,000 项任务，其中训练集有 1,700 项任务，测试集有 300 项任务。 这些分区互不相交。 测试集包含六种编程语言和 67 个仓库及项目中的 3000 个带标签的实现。

paragraphs.en: Coverage. Following SWT Bench, Change Coverage ( Δ ​ 𝒞 \Delta\mathcal{C} ) measures the fraction of executable reference changes exercised by generated tests; trusted tests identify targets in the corresponding initial or reference state ( Mündler et al., 2025 ) . Following TestExplora, Entry Coverage measures coverage of executable code within production entry spans identified by trusted tests in the reference state, potentially beyond changed lines ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Failed collection and empty denominators yield no numeric value; we report collection counts (Appendix B.6.2 ).

paragraphs.en: To improve test reliability beyond a single reference implementation, we propose TestHelix with three components (Figure 2 ). Heterogeneous synthesis generates diverse test and repair pairs to explore complementary behaviors and implementation hypotheses. Peer cross validation checks tests against peer repairs to expose and correct errors that agreement with one repair can miss. Recursive self improvement (RSI) learns from execution feedback across tasks to improve the test generation strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 为了超越单一参考实现来提升测试可靠性，我们提出了包含三个组件的 TestHelix（图 2）。 异构合成会生成多样化的测试与修复对，以探索互补的行为和实现假设。 同伴交叉验证通过用同伴修复来检验测试，从而揭示并纠正那些仅依赖单一修复可能遗漏的错误。 递归自我改进（RSI）通过跨任务的学习执行反馈，来优化测试生成策略。

sents.en: Heterogeneous synthesis generates diverse test and repair pairs to explore complementary behaviors and implementation hypotheses.
sents.zh: 异构合成会生成多样化的测试与修复对，以探索互补的行为和实现假设。

sents.en: Peer cross validation checks tests against peer repairs to expose and correct errors that agreement with one repair can miss.
sents.zh: 同伴交叉验证通过用同伴修复来检验测试，从而揭示并纠正那些仅依赖单一修复可能遗漏的错误。

sents.en: Recursive self improvement (RSI) learns from execution feedback across tasks to improve the test generation strategy.
sents.zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）通过跨任务的学习执行反馈，来优化测试生成策略。

paragraphs.en: Diversity. We encourage diversity by assigning distinct exploration strategies to isolated coding agents. Each agent independently develops a test patch T k T_{k} and a repair patch P k P_{k} from public task requirements. Internal consistency. We enforce internal consistency within each pair by requiring T k T_{k} to reproducibly fail on the initial program and pass on P k P_{k} . Agents use local execution feedback to refine their pairs until this condition holds or the budget is exhausted. Appendix C.1 details the synthesis prompts and branch strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 多样性。 我们通过为独立的编码智能体分配不同的探索策略来促进多样性。 每个智能体都根据公开的作业要求独立开发一个测试补丁 T k T_{k} 和一个修复补丁 P k P_{k}。内部一致性。 我们通过在初始程序上要求 T k T_{k} 可重复地失败，而在 P k P_{k} 上要求其通过，来确保每对补丁的内部一致性。 智能体利用本地执行反馈来优化它们的补丁对，直到满足此条件或预算耗尽。 附录 C.1 详细说明了合成提示和分支策略。

paragraphs.en: Cross execution. We execute T i T_{i} against internally consistent peer repairs P j P_{j} to expose overly restrictive tests or incomplete repairs. Semantic review. An independent reviewer checks assertions against public requirements without seeing generated repairs and supports every blocking finding with public evidence. Corrective feedback. We use reviewed counterexamples to correct the pairs. When distinct qualified repairs pass the approved suites, we use differential challenges to find inputs that separate them ( Yang et al., 2011 ) . We repeat execution and review after revision. Suite merging. We combine compatible suites with common passing witnesses and validate the merged suite in a fresh environment. Appendix C.2 documents the review prompt and evidence boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 跨执行。 我们将 T i T_{i} 与内部一致的同行修复 P j P_{j} 进行执行，以暴露过度严格的测试或不完整的修复。语义审查。 独立审查员在不查看已生成的修复方案的情况下，依据公开要求检查断言，并为每一项阻止性发现提供公开证据支持。纠正性反馈。 我们使用经过审查的反例来修正这些配对。 当不同的合格修复方案通过已批准的测试套件时，我们会使用差异挑战来寻找能够区分它们的输入（Yang et al., 2011）。 在修订后，我们重复执行和审查流程。套件合并。 我们将具有共同通过见证的兼容套件进行组合，并在全新的环境中验证合并后的套件。 附录 C.2 记录了审查提示词和证据边界。

sents.en: Cross execution.
sents.zh: 跨执行。

sents.en: We execute T i T_{i} against internally consistent peer repairs P j P_{j} to expose overly restrictive tests or incomplete repairs. Semantic review.
sents.zh: 我们将 T i T_{i} 与内部一致的同行修复 P j P_{j} 进行执行，以暴露过度严格的测试或不完整的修复。语义审查。

sents.en: An independent reviewer checks assertions against public requirements without seeing generated repairs and supports every blocking finding with public evidence. Corrective feedback.
sents.zh: 独立审查员在不查看已生成的修复方案的情况下，依据公开要求检查断言，并为每一项阻止性发现提供公开证据支持。纠正性反馈。

sents.en: We use reviewed counterexamples to correct the pairs.
sents.zh: 我们使用经过审查的反例来修正这些配对。

sents.en: When distinct qualified repairs pass the approved suites, we use differential challenges to find inputs that separate them ( Yang et al., 2011 ) .
sents.zh: 当不同的合格修复方案通过已批准的测试套件时，我们会使用差异挑战来寻找能够区分它们的输入（Yang et al., 2011）。

sents.en: We repeat execution and review after revision. Suite merging.
sents.zh: 在修订后，我们重复执行和审查流程。套件合并。

sents.en: We combine compatible suites with common passing witnesses and validate the merged suite in a fresh environment.
sents.zh: 我们将具有共同通过见证的兼容套件进行组合，并在全新的环境中验证合并后的套件。

sents.zh: 附录 C.2 记录了审查提示词和证据边界。

paragraphs.en: We initialize TestHelix with a basic strategy. However, improving test generation performance across heterogeneous tasks involves a large semantic search space. We use RSI to refine the strategy within the existing workflow while keeping the pair count and inference budget fixed. We optimize Reference Acceptance Rate for a denser success signal, since the stricter Joint Success Function can leave incremental harness improvements unrewarded. Heterogeneous synthesis and peer cross validation target the broader discrimination across implementations required by Joint Success Function.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一种基础策略来初始化 TestHelix。 然而，在异构任务中提升测试生成性能涉及一个巨大的语义搜索空间。 我们在现有工作流中使用 RSI 来优化策略，同时保持对偶数量与推理预算不变。 我们优化参考接受率以获得更密集的成功信号，因为更严格的联合成功函数可能会使渐进式的测试框架改进得不到回报。 异构合成与同伴交叉验证旨在应对联合成功函数所要求的、跨不同实现方式的更广泛区分能力。

paragraphs.en: We use AutoSaddler ( Park et al., 2026 ) to optimize the harness strategy through reflective evolution. It selects a parent strategy, diagnoses its execution traces, and proposes a revision. The parent and child are evaluated on the same tasks using Reference Acceptance Rate; their performance guides selection, while reflection extracts reusable lessons for later rounds. Appendix C.3 details the optimization setup.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 AutoSaddler（Park 等人，2026）通过反思性演化来优化 harness 策略。 它会选择一个父策略，诊断其执行轨迹，并提出修订方案。 父策略和子策略在相同任务上基于参考接受率进行评估；它们的表现指导选择过程，而反思则提取可复用的经验用于后续轮次。 附录 C.3 详细说明了优化设置。

paragraphs.en: To assess test reliability across implementations, we investigate the following Research Questions (RQs): RQ1 benchmarks coding agents and relates coverage to success; RQ2 examines how expanding diverse candidate patch sets affects Joint Success Function; RQ3 characterizes test generation failures; and RQ4 evaluates TestHelix and its components. Evaluations follow the shared protocol in Section 2.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估不同实现中测试的可靠性，我们研究了以下研究问题（RQ）：RQ1 对编码智能体进行基准测试，并将覆盖范围与成功情况相关联；RQ2 考察扩展多样化的候选补丁集如何影响联合成功函数；RQ3 描述测试生成失败的特征；RQ4 评估 TestHelix 及其各组件。 评估遵循第 2.6 节中共享的协议。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 benchmarks coding agents on all 300 tasks, reporting the highest Joint Success Function configuration from each of six model families among fourteen evaluated configurations. The main comparison uses native coding agents to reflect the close coupling between model training and harness design. Appendix D.1.1 provides the remaining eight configurations, including earlier versions and model variants. paragraphs.en: Reference success often fails to extend to other implementations. Claude Fable 5.1 leads Joint Success Function at 28.00%, compared with 59.67% against the reference. GLM 5.3 has the highest rejection rate but the lowest acceptance and joint success rates: defect rejection alone is insufficient. Change Coverage and Entry Coverage also correlate with joint success (Pearson r = 0.91 r=0.91 and 0.96 0.96 ). Reaching relevant behavior helps, but does not ensure that assertions judge it correctly ( Inozemtseva & Holmes, 2014 ; Zhu et al., 1997 ) .

paragraphs.en: The profiles in Figure 4 (a) show contrasting strengths: GPT 5.6 sol -max and GLM 5.3 reject invalid candidates more reliably than they accept valid alternatives, whereas Qwen3.8 Max shows the reverse. Panel (b) summarizes 99 coverage gaps (34.6%), 143 faulty checks (50.0%), and 44 execution logic errors (15.4%). Coverage gaps. Tests can exercise an operation while missing the input combinations that expose a defect. A poker suite never compares an ace low straight against three of a kind, allowing a candidate that misclassifies the straight as a high card to pass. Faulty checks. The largest group shows that exercising relevant behavior does not ensure that tests judge it correctly, consistent with prior observations of incorrect generated assertions ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) . A bracket parser suite includes unmatched parentheses but checks only the output count, accepting a candidate that discards valid groups. Both the poker and bracket suites fail on the initial program and pass on the reference, yet accept an invalid alternative. These paired outcomes show how missing input combinations and weak assertions can survive reference evaluation while additional patches expose them. Execution logic errors. Errors in the tests’ own execution can also prevent them from evaluating candidate behavior. An EvoEval suite accesses a function stored on its test class through self , unintentionally binding an extra argument and failing even on the reference repair. Such failures explain broader reliability problems but do not establish a single reference blind spot.
paragraphs.zh: 图4(a)中的配置文件显示出截然不同的优势：GPT 5.6 sol -max和GLM 5.3在拒绝无效候选项方面比接受有效替代方案更可靠，而Qwen3.8 Max则正好相反。 (b)部分总结了99处覆盖缺口（34.6%）、143处错误检查（50.0%）以及44处执行逻辑错误（15.4%）。覆盖缺口。 测试可能在执行某个操作的同时，遗漏了能够暴露缺陷的输入组合。 扑克测试套件从未将低牌A的顺子与三条牌进行比较，导致错误地将顺子误判为高牌的候选项能够通过。错误检查。 最大的问题组表明，即使测试执行了相关行为，也不保证能正确判断该行为，这与先前关于生成断言错误的观察一致（Yuan等，2024）。 括号解析器套件包含了未匹配的括号，但仅检查输出数量，导致接受一个丢弃了有效分组的候选项。 扑克和括号测试套件在初始程序上均失败，但在参考程序上通过，却同时接受了一个无效的替代方案。 这些成对的结果表明，输入组合的缺失和断言的薄弱如何能在参考评估中幸存下来，而额外的补丁却能暴露这些问题。执行逻辑错误。 测试自身执行中的错误也可能导致其无法正确评估候选项的行为。 一个EvoEval套件通过self访问存储在其测试类中的一个函数，无意中绑定了一个多余的参数，甚至在参考修复版本上也失败了。 此类失败可以解释更广泛的可靠性问题，但并未证明存在单一的参考盲点。

sents.en: The profiles in Figure 4 (a) show contrasting strengths: GPT 5.6 sol -max and GLM 5.3 reject invalid candidates more reliably than they accept valid alternatives, whereas Qwen3.8 Max shows the reverse.
sents.zh: 图4(a)中的配置文件显示出截然不同的优势：GPT 5.6 sol -max和GLM 5.3在拒绝无效候选项方面比接受有效替代方案更可靠，而Qwen3.8 Max则正好相反。

sents.en: Panel (b) summarizes 99 coverage gaps (34.6%), 143 faulty checks (50.0%), and 44 execution logic errors (15.4%). Coverage gaps.
sents.zh: (b)部分总结了99处覆盖缺口（34.6%）、143处错误检查（50.0%）以及44处执行逻辑错误（15.4%）。覆盖缺口。

sents.en: Tests can exercise an operation while missing the input combinations that expose a defect.
sents.zh: 测试可能在执行某个操作的同时，遗漏了能够暴露缺陷的输入组合。

sents.en: A poker suite never compares an ace low straight against three of a kind, allowing a candidate that misclassifies the straight as a high card to pass. Faulty checks.
sents.zh: 扑克测试套件从未将低牌A的顺子与三条牌进行比较，导致错误地将顺子误判为高牌的候选项能够通过。错误检查。

sents.en: The largest group shows that exercising relevant behavior does not ensure that tests judge it correctly, consistent with prior observations of incorrect generated assertions ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 最大的问题组表明，即使测试执行了相关行为，也不保证能正确判断该行为，这与先前关于生成断言错误的观察一致（Yuan等，2024）。

sents.en: A bracket parser suite includes unmatched parentheses but checks only the output count, accepting a candidate that discards valid groups.
sents.zh: 括号解析器套件包含了未匹配的括号，但仅检查输出数量，导致接受一个丢弃了有效分组的候选项。

sents.en: Both the poker and bracket suites fail on the initial program and pass on the reference, yet accept an invalid alternative.
sents.zh: 扑克和括号测试套件在初始程序上均失败，但在参考程序上通过，却同时接受了一个无效的替代方案。

sents.en: These paired outcomes show how missing input combinations and weak assertions can survive reference evaluation while additional patches expose them. Execution logic errors.
sents.zh: 这些成对的结果表明，输入组合的缺失和断言的薄弱如何能在参考评估中幸存下来，而额外的补丁却能暴露这些问题。执行逻辑错误。

sents.en: Errors in the tests’ own execution can also prevent them from evaluating candidate behavior.
sents.zh: 测试自身执行中的错误也可能导致其无法正确评估候选项的行为。

sents.en: Such failures explain broader reliability problems but do not establish a single reference blind spot.
sents.zh: 此类失败可以解释更广泛的可靠性问题，但并未证明存在单一的参考盲点。

paragraphs.en: How do heterogeneous synthesis, peer cross validation, and recursive self improvement contribute to joint test reliability?
paragraphs.zh: 异质合成、同伴交叉验证和递归自我改进如何共同提升测试可靠性？

paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares five TestHelix configurations for GPT 5.6 sol and Kimi K3, alongside native agent comparators, Codex (max) and Kimi Code, respectively. Within each model group, the TestHelix configurations share the same base model and tools and use the same total inference cap per benchmark task, shared across pairs. We compare single pair generation with three heterogeneous pairs followed by random submission of one locally qualified suite, then enable peer cross validation at K = 3 K=3 and K = 5 K=5 . The final configuration applies RSI at K = 3 K=3 using one shared strategy optimized with Opus 4.6 on 600 training tasks for Reference Acceptance Rate and frozen for evaluation with both models. The other configurations retain the initial strategy. Appendix D.4 provides the experimental controls, and Appendix C.3 details the strategy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 比较了 GPT 5.6 sol 和 Kimi K3 的五种 TestHelix 配置，以及原生智能体比较器 Codex（最大）和 Kimi Code。 在每个模型组中，TestHelix 配置共享相同的基模型和工具，并且每个基准任务使用相同的总推理上限，该上限在成对测试中共享。 我们首先比较了单对生成与三个异构对的组合，随后随机提交一个本地合格的套件，然后在 K = 3 和 K = 5 时启用同伴交叉验证。 最终配置在 K = 3 时应用 RSI，使用通过 Opus 4.6 在 600 个训练任务上针对参考接受率进行优化的单一共享策略，并在评估时对该策略进行冻结，以同时评估两个模型。 其他配置则保留初始策略。 附录 D.4 提供了实验对照，附录 C.3 详细描述了策略优化过程。

paragraphs.en: Across both models, larger gains come from using the generated pairs to improve tests than from heterogeneous synthesis without peer cross validation. Generating three heterogeneous pairs and randomly submitting one improves Joint Success Function by at most one percentage point over single pair generation. Enabling the complete peer cross validation process at the same K = 3 K=3 adds more than six points, supporting the use of alternative repair hypotheses to challenge, refine, and select tests before submission. Expanding peer cross validation to five pairs yields only 0.67 additional points, whereas RSI improves the three pair process by 4.33 to 4.67 points. Under these inference caps, improving how tests are generated and checked therefore offers a larger gain than allocating the budget to additional pairs. The evolved configuration achieves the highest Joint Success Function for both models and exceeds their native coding agents, suggesting that the generation workflow remains a useful target for improving reliability with a fixed base model.
paragraphs.zh: 在两种模型中，使用生成的配对来改进测试所带来的收益，要大于在没有同伴交叉验证的情况下进行异构合成所带来的收益。 生成三个异构配对并随机提交其中一个，与仅生成单个配对相比，最多只能将联合成功函数提升一个百分点。 在 K = 3 时启用完整的同伴交叉验证流程，可使分数增加超过六分，这支持了在提交前使用替代修复假设来挑战、优化和筛选测试的做法。 将同伴交叉验证扩展到五个配对仅能带来 0.67 分的额外提升，而 RSI 则能使三个配对的流程提升 4.33 至 4.67 分。 在这些推理限制下，改进测试的生成和检查方式所带来的收益，因此比将预算分配给更多配对更大。 演化后的配置在两种模型中都实现了最高的联合成功函数，并超过了其原生编码智能体，这表明在固定基础模型的情况下，生成工作流程仍然是提升可靠性的有效目标。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents and test generation benchmarks. SWE bench evaluates repository changes with executable tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) ; Terminal Bench assesses command line tasks ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , and ContextBench evaluates context retrieval ( Li et al., 2026c ) . SWT Bench studies tests derived from GitHub issues ( Mündler et al., 2025 ) ; RESTestBench evaluates requirement based REST API tests using related mutants ( Kogler et al., 2026 ) . TestPrism evaluates test generation across heterogeneous sources using fixed valid and invalid implementation panels. TestHelix uses AutoSaddler ( Park et al., 2026 ) to search a large semantic space of test generation strategies, drawing on Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) and prior work on reflective feedback and prompt optimization ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Khattab et al., 2023 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体与测试生成基准。 SWE bench 通过可执行测试评估代码库变更（Jimenez 等，2024；Yang 等，2024b）；Terminal Bench 评估命令行任务（Merrill 等，2026），而 ContextBench 则评估上下文检索能力（Li 等，2026c）。 SWT Bench 研究源自 GitHub 问题的测试（Mündler 等，2025）；RESTestBench 使用相关变异体评估基于需求的 REST API 测试（Kogler 等，2026）。 TestPrism 利用固定的有效与无效实现面板，评估来自异构来源的测试生成能力。 TestHelix 使用 AutoSaddler（Park 等，2026）在庞大的测试生成策略语义空间中进行搜索，并借鉴 Meta-Harness（Lee 等，2026）以及关于反思性反馈与提示优化的早期研究（Shinn 等，2023；Khattab 等，2023；Yuksekgonul 等，2024；Agrawal 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Test generation and coverage. Randoop and EvoSuite use random generation and search ( Pacheco & Ernst, 2007 ; Fraser & Arcuri, 2011 ) . Language model approaches evaluate execution and coverage ( Schäfer et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) . CodaMOSA and CoverUp use coverage feedback to guide generation ( Lemieux et al., 2023 ; Pizzorno & Berger, 2025 ) , while SymPrompt structures prompts around execution paths ( Ryan et al., 2024 ) . TestExplora studies repository test generation and Entry Coverage ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . TestPrism reports task scoped coverage alongside behavioral discrimination.

paragraphs.en: Test adequacy and executable oracles. Mutation testing assesses rejection of faulty variants ( Jia & Harman, 2011 ) . PROBE augments repair benchmark tests with reference variants and checks robustness under behavior preserving transformations ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Joint Success Function jointly requires acceptance of valid and rejection of invalid candidates. The oracle problem and patch plausibility limit executable verdicts ( Barr et al., 2015 ; Qi et al., 2015 ) : broader observed behavior does not establish label completeness or semantic correctness. CodeT selects code through agreement with generated tests ( Chen et al., 2022 ) ; CodeRL combines test feedback with a learned critic to refine code ( Le et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 测试充分性与可执行预言机。 变异测试评估对错误变体的拒绝（Jia & Harman, 2011）。 PROBE 通过引入参考变体来增强修复基准测试，并检验其在行为保持变换下的稳健性（Li et al., 2026a）。 联合成功函数同时要求接受有效候选体并拒绝无效候选体。 预言机问题和补丁合理性限制了可执行判决（Barr et al., 2015；Qi et al., 2015）：更广泛观察到的行为并不能证明标签的完整性或语义正确性。 CodeT 通过与生成的测试一致来选择代码（Chen et al., 2022）；CodeRL 将测试反馈与学习到的批评者结合以优化代码（Le et al., 2022）。

paragraphs.en: We introduced TestPrism to evaluate generated tests beyond a single reference. Its Joint Success Function checks acceptance of valid alternatives and rejection of defective implementations across diverse candidate sets. Our evaluation reveals persistent limitations in frontier coding agents; analysis of 286 retained failed trajectories across six model families identifies coverage gaps, faulty checks, and execution logic errors. TestHelix improves joint success through heterogeneous synthesis, peer cross validation, and recursive self improvement, supporting more reliable test generation across implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了 TestPrism，以便超越单一参考标准来评估生成的测试。 其联合成功函数能够检验有效替代方案的接受情况，并拒绝不同候选集合中的缺陷实现。 我们的评估揭示了前沿编码智能体持续存在的局限性；对六个模型家族中保留的 286 条失败轨迹的分析，识别出了覆盖范围不足、检查逻辑错误以及执行逻辑问题。 TestHelix 通过异构合成、同行交叉验证和递归自我改进提升了联合成功率，从而支持跨不同实现的更可靠测试生成。

sents.en: We introduced TestPrism to evaluate generated tests beyond a single reference.
sents.zh: 我们引入了 TestPrism，以便超越单一参考标准来评估生成的测试。

sents.en: Its Joint Success Function checks acceptance of valid alternatives and rejection of defective implementations across diverse candidate sets.
sents.zh: 其联合成功函数能够检验有效替代方案的接受情况，并拒绝不同候选集合中的缺陷实现。

sents.en: Our evaluation reveals persistent limitations in frontier coding agents; analysis of 286 retained failed trajectories across six model families identifies coverage gaps, faulty checks, and execution logic errors.
sents.zh: 我们的评估揭示了前沿编码智能体持续存在的局限性；对六个模型家族中保留的 286 条失败轨迹的分析，识别出了覆盖范围不足、检查逻辑错误以及执行逻辑问题。

sents.en: TestHelix improves joint success through heterogeneous synthesis, peer cross validation, and recursive self improvement, supporting more reliable test generation across implementations.
sents.zh: TestHelix 通过异构合成、同行交叉验证和递归自我改进提升了联合成功率，从而支持跨不同实现的更可靠测试生成。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares behavioral and coverage targets: a check marks the corresponding target, a dagger marks a related check with different granularity or definitions, and a cross marks its absence from the main protocol. Reference Acceptance Rate measures the fail to pass transition from the initial program to the reference implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 比较了行为目标和覆盖目标：对勾表示对应的目标，匕首符号表示相关但对粒度或定义不同的目标，而叉号则表示该目标未包含在主协议中。 参考接受率衡量的是从初始程序到参考实现的失败至通过转换。

paragraphs.en: TestGenEval uses mutation testing; CLOVER and MultiFileTest evaluate tests through execution and code coverage ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Their file, block, or project coverage is distinct from reference change and entry scope coverage. SWT Bench and TDD Bench Verified measure changed code coverage ( Mündler et al., 2025 ; Ahmed et al., 2024 ) . OmniCode jointly requires reference acceptance and rejection of all bad patches, while SWE Mutation reports mutant detection ( Sonwane et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . These checks provide evidence beyond one reference; acceptance of valid alternatives under Joint Success Function is outside their scope.
paragraphs.zh: TestGenEval 使用变异测试；CLOVER 和 MultiFileTest 通过执行和代码覆盖来评估测试（Jain 等，2025；Xu 等，2025a；Wang 等，2026b）。 它们的文件、块或项目覆盖范围与参考变更和条目作用域覆盖范围不同。 SWT Bench 和 TDD Bench Verified 测量已变更代码的覆盖范围（Mündler 等，2025；Ahmed 等，2024）。 OmniCode 需要同时接受参考并拒绝所有不良补丁，而 SWE Mutation 则报告变异体检测情况（Sonwane 等，2026；Sun 等，2026）。 这些检查提供的证据超出了单个参考的范围；在联合成功函数下接受有效替代方案则不在其作用域之内。

paragraphs.en: Variants counts implementations other than the reference, including mutants; a check indicates that variants are used but no total is established. SWT Bench’s separate patch filtering experiment is outside that column’s main protocol scope. TestPrism has 2,700 such variants and 300 reference solutions. Languages counts individual task implementation languages. The 300 TestPrism tasks use Python (205), TypeScript (44), Java (19), JavaScript (16), C++ (8), and Go (8). Scope identifies test granularity; TestPrism spans local function and file tests, multifile projects, and repository issues.

paragraphs.en: Source selection and prior evidence. We select public benchmarks with traceable task origins and documented test validation. The SWE bench and Terminal Bench families maintain public leaderboards with results from multiple agent developers. Other sources draw on community maintained Exercism exercises, official USACO competitions, and published benchmarks for specialized programming settings.
paragraphs.zh: 来源选择与先验证据。 我们选择任务来源可追溯且测试验证有记录公开的基准数据集。 SWE bench 和 Terminal Bench 系列维护着包含多位智能体开发者结果的公开排行榜。 其他来源则参考社区维护的 Exercism 练习、官方 USACO 竞赛以及针对特定编程场景的已发布基准数据集。

paragraphs.en: Task adaptation. We retain tasks centered on code and suitable for executable test authoring, excluding tasks with unusable Docker images or environments that cannot be reproduced. Adapters map tasks from all 17 source benchmarks to Harbor’s instruction, environment, tests, and solution components. Dependencies, services, and execution limits follow each source so that its original functional and performance requirements can be checked.
paragraphs.zh: 任务适配。 我们保留以代码为中心且适合编写可执行测试的任务，排除使用不可用 Docker 镜像或无法复现环境的任务。 适配器将所有 17 个源基准测试中的任务映射到 Harbor 的指令、环境、测试和解决方案组件上。 依赖项、服务和执行限制均遵循每个源基准测试，以便可以验证其原有的功能和性能要求。

sents.zh: 我们保留以代码为中心且适合编写可执行测试的任务，排除使用不可用 Docker 镜像或无法复现环境的任务。

paragraphs.en: Initial screening excludes tasks outside the code testing scope and tasks whose environments cannot be reproduced. The selection signals in Section 2.2 use effective lines in solution.sh , excluding blank and comment lines ( solution_lines ); test functions enumerated from source files or benchmark test metadata ( test_func_count ); and this count divided by the number of detected modified files, with a minimum denominator of one ( test_coverage_ratio ). The ratio describes test density. We apply source-specific lower bounds calibrated to each source’s distribution. Sources with smaller typical solutions or lower enumerated test counts use correspondingly lower bounds, preserving their representation alongside sources with larger values. This accounts for differences in task granularity and verifier structure; source quotas additionally balance the benchmark composition. After enrichment, final admission requires applicability annotations for both Δ ​ 𝒞 \Delta\mathcal{C} and Entry Coverage, ten physical candidate artifacts meeting the diversity criteria in Appendix B.4 , and agreement between each artifact digest and its manifest.
paragraphs.zh: 初步筛选会排除不在代码测试范围内的任务，以及无法复现其环境的任务。 第 2.2 节中的选择信号使用 solution.sh 中的有效行（排除空行和注释行，即 solution_lines）；从源文件或基准测试元数据中枚举的测试函数数量（test_func_count）；以及该数量除以检测到的已修改文件数所得的比率，分母最小取一（test_coverage_ratio）。 该比率描述了测试密度。 我们为每个源文件的分布情况应用经过校准的源特定下限。 典型解决方案规模较小或枚举出的测试函数数量较少的源文件，会使用相应较低的下限，从而在与数值较大的源文件一同保留其代表性。 这考虑了任务粒度和验证器结构上的差异；源文件配额还能进一步平衡基准测试的组成。 经过丰富处理后，最终纳入需满足以下条件：对 Δ 𝒞 \Delta\mathcal{C} 和入口覆盖性均具备适用性标注、有十个符合附录 B.4 中多样性标准的物理候选工件，且每个工件的摘要与其清单一致。

sents.zh: 初步筛选会排除不在代码测试范围内的任务，以及无法复现其环境的任务。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 lists the source-specific thresholds applied during difficulty screening. Source test counts follow the complete and partial enumeration convention in Appendix B.5 . Density uses original patch paths for 204 tasks and reference file changes reconstructed from initial task files and build specifications for the remaining 96. It counts distinct changed, added, or removed files, including code, configuration, tests, and documentation; unchanged rewrites, temporary helpers, and runtime or build outputs are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 列出了在难度筛选期间应用的各数据源特定阈值。 数据源测试次数遵循附录 B.5 中完整的枚举和部分的枚举惯例。 密度计算使用原始分块路径处理 204 项任务，其余 96 项则使用从初始任务文件和构建规范中重构的参考文件变更进行计算。 该计算统计独立变更、新增或移除的文件，包括代码、配置、测试和文档；未变更的重写、临时辅助文件以及运行时或构建输出均被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Tasks are normalized across sources and deduplicated before partitioning. Difficulty screening operates within source benchmarks. Source quotas form a training set of 1,700 tasks and a disjoint candidate test pool. The training set is fixed at this stage; candidate test tasks continue through verifier validation, patch generation, and diversity filtering. We select the final 300 eligible test tasks with proportional source quotas, retaining every source, and seed 42 for sampling within each source. Tasks not selected for the final test set are excluded from its statistics. Candidate test tasks undergo the verifier checks and independent human review described in Appendix B.3.1 before final admission.
paragraphs.zh: 任务在不同来源间进行标准化处理，并在分区前去重。 难度筛选在来源基准范围内执行。 来源配额构成一个包含 1,700 个任务的训练集和一个互斥的候选测试池。 在此阶段，训练集已固定；候选测试任务则继续经过验证器验证、补丁生成和多样性过滤。 我们根据来源配额的比例选择最终 300 个合格的测试任务，保留所有来源，并为每个来源的采样设置种子为 42。 未被选入最终测试集的任务将排除在其统计之外。 候选测试任务在最终入选前，需经过附录 B.3.1 中描述的验证器检查和独立人工审核。

paragraphs.en: Selection uses task properties and artifact availability, independently of Reference Acceptance Rate, Joint Success Function, or coverage collection success. Test set membership remains fixed when runtime observations are missing.
paragraphs.zh: 选择过程会利用任务属性和可用成果，且不受参考接受率、联合成功函数或覆盖收集成功与否的影响。 当运行时观测数据缺失时，测试集的成员资格保持不变。

sents.zh: 选择过程会利用任务属性和可用成果，且不受参考接受率、联合成功函数或覆盖收集成功与否的影响。

sents.en: Test set membership remains fixed when runtime observations are missing.
sents.zh: 当运行时观测数据缺失时，测试集的成员资格保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Filtering funnel. Table 5 summarizes construction from an initial pool of 15,148 source tasks. The final dataset contains 1,700 training tasks and 300 test tasks. All entries count tasks, including stages that assess their patch sets. Source quota exclusions denote tasks left unselected, rather than failures of the quality checks. After the split, the training set remains fixed and only the candidate test pool continues through verifier validation, initial panel assembly, and diversity refinement. Initial assembly requires one reference, four valid alternatives, and five invalid implementations. Tasks that exhaust the shared generation budget before filling these quotas fail initial assembly. Tasks that fill the quotas but still fail either group criterion when the same budget is exhausted are excluded during diversity refinement (Appendix B.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 过滤漏斗。 表5总结了从初始的15,148个源任务池中构建数据集的过程。 最终数据集包含1,700个训练任务和300个测试任务。 所有条目都统计了任务数量，包括评估其补丁集的各个阶段。 源配额排除项表示未被选中的任务，而非质量检查失败的任务。 划分完成后，训练集保持固定，仅候选测试池继续通过验证器验证、初始面板构建和多样性优化流程。 初始构建需要一个参考任务、四个有效替代方案以及五个无效实现。 在填满这些配额之前用尽共享生成预算的任务，会在初始构建阶段失败。 填满配额但在用尽相同预算时仍未能满足任一分组标准任务，将在多样性优化阶段被排除（附录B.4）。

sents.en: Filtering funnel.
sents.zh: 过滤漏斗。

paragraphs.en: Additional validation after adaptation. The source benchmarks provide the original validation; our additional validation round checks the adapted verifiers before candidate generation. We preserve the source verifiers during adaptation and require them to reject the initial state and accept the reference solution before using them to label candidates. For performance tasks, failure means the initial, unaccelerated program misses the task’s performance requirement; passing requires an accelerated solution that meets the original task-defined thresholds while preserving functional correctness. Candidate labels are established independently of the generated tests under evaluation and remain fixed across agents.
paragraphs.zh: 适配后的额外验证。 源基准测试提供原始验证；我们的额外验证环节会在生成候选方案前检查经过适配的验证器。 我们在适配过程中保留源验证器，并要求它们在用于标注候选方案之前，拒绝初始状态并接受参考解决方案。 对于性能任务，失败意味着未经加速的初始程序未能满足该任务的性能要求；而通过则要求加速后的解决方案在保持功能正确性的同时，满足任务原始定义的门限。 候选方案的标注独立于正在评估的生成测试确定，并且在不同智能体之间保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Independent verifier review. Before candidate generation, two experts independently review the task requirements and source verifier, judging whether the available information supports test authoring. Drawing on development experience, they assess potential overfitting to the reference and gaps in requirement coverage, including checks that could reject valid alternatives or miss incorrect behavior. Disagreements are discussed to clarify the concerns; any task with a remaining concern about verifier usability is excluded. Agreement on the independent usability judgments, before adjudication, is Cohen’s κ = 0.68 \kappa=0.68 . This review complements the source validation procedures and automatic execution checks; retained candidate labels follow the verifier outcomes defined in Section 2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 独立验证者评审。 在生成候选项之前，两位专家会独立审查任务要求和原始验证者，判断可用信息是否支持测试编写。 他们结合开发经验，评估可能对参考答案出现过拟合的风险以及需求覆盖的空白，包括可能拒绝有效替代方案或遗漏错误行为的检查点。 若存在分歧，双方将进行讨论以澄清疑虑；任何在验证器可用性方面仍存在疑虑的任务均被排除。 在最终裁定前，两位专家对独立可用性判断的一致性达到 Cohen’s κ = 0.68 \kappa=0.68 。 此次评审是对原始验证程序和自动执行检查的补充；保留的候选标签遵循第 2.3 节中定义的验证结果。

paragraphs.en: Only the candidate test pool undergoes patch generation, using different coding agents and models of varying capabilities to produce alternative implementations. These runs capture multiple ways of satisfying the task requirements and errors arising during task solving. Each candidate is stored as a patch artifact. The admission gate removes empty submissions and exact duplicates, then checks applicability in the adapted task environment. The source verifier executes its checks in a clean environment, producing a matrix of candidate outcomes. A candidate is valid when every check passes and invalid when any check fails, regardless of its intended correctness. We retain its provenance, identifier, label, and digest for selection and evaluation. Each task has a single budget of 30 generated patch outputs, shared by initial panel assembly and diversity refinement. The existing reference does not consume this budget. Every produced patch counts once, including patches later rejected or not selected. No per-label generation cap or separate refinement-round cap applies.
paragraphs.zh: 仅候选测试池会进行补丁生成，使用不同编码能力的智能体和模型来产生替代实现。 这些运行过程记录了满足任务需求的多种方法以及任务解决过程中出现的错误。 每个候选项都作为补丁工件存储。 准入机制会移除空提交和完全重复的提交，然后检查其在适配后的任务环境中的适用性。 源验证器在干净的环境中执行检查，生成一个候选结果矩阵。 当所有检查均通过时，候选项即为有效；只要有任何一项检查失败，无论其预期正确性如何，均为无效。 我们会保留其来源、标识符、标签和摘要，用于选择和评估。 每个任务仅有 30 个生成的补丁输出配额，该配额由初始面板构建和多样性优化共享使用。 现有的参考项不占用此配额。 每个生成的补丁都计为一次，包括后续被拒绝或未选中的补丁。 不存在按标签划分的生成上限或独立的优化轮次上限。

paragraphs.en: AST distance. We apply each patch to the same initial program and parse the modified production code before and after the change with fixed versions of Tree-sitter and the corresponding language grammars. From AST nodes in the modified regions on each side, we extract ordered local subtrees of depth three, counting the root as depth zero. Features preserve node types, child order, operators, and literal types and values. Identifiers are normalized to a common token; comments, formatting, and source positions do not contribute features.
paragraphs.zh: AST 距离。 我们将每个补丁应用于相同的初始程序，并使用固定版本的 Tree-sitter 及相应的语言文法解析修改前后生成的代码。 从两侧修改区域中的 AST 节点出发，我们提取深度为三的有序局部子树，其中根节点计为深度零。 特征保留了节点类型、子节点顺序、运算符以及字面量类型和值。 标识符被归约为一个通用标记；注释、格式化和源位置信息不贡献任何特征。

paragraphs.en: For invalid implementations, we first compare the sets of verifier checks they fail. Different failed-check sets satisfy the diversity check directly. Candidates with the same failed-check set must additionally pass the AST Jaccard check. Thus, AST filtering within the invalid group is conditional on matching failed-check sets. We impose no cross-group distance constraint: verifier outcomes already distinguish implementations that pass all checks from those that fail at least one.
paragraphs.zh: 对于无效的实现，我们首先比较它们未能通过的验证器检查集合。 不同的未通过检查集合可以直接满足多样性检查。 具有相同未通过检查集合的候选者还必须额外通过 AST Jaccard 检查。 因此，无效组内的 AST 过滤以未通过检查集合匹配为前提条件。 我们不施加跨组距离约束：验证器结果已经能够区分所有检查都通过的实现与至少一项检查未通过的实现。

paragraphs.en: Generation and replacement. If either group fails its criterion, we continue generating candidates. Each new candidate undergoes the same applicability, deduplication, and verifier checks. Its observed label determines the group it can enter. When the valid group has not met its criterion, we evaluate each replacement of a nonreference member and choose the one that maximizes D ⁡ ( V ) D(V) , accepting it only if the mean strictly increases. For the invalid group, replacements are assessed by their failed-check sets, with the AST Jaccard check applied when those sets match. The reference remains fixed, and the panel always contains one reference, four valid alternatives, and five invalid implementations. We stop as soon as both criteria hold or after evaluating the thirtieth generated patch. At that limit, tasks without a complete panel satisfying both criteria are excluded. Final source quotas select from the eligible tasks; tasks left unselected at this stage have passed the quality filters. Every retained artifact must match its recorded digest.
paragraphs.zh: 生成与替换。 如果任一组别未能满足其标准，我们将继续生成候选项。 每个新候选项都会经过相同的适用性、去重和验证器检查。 其观察到的标签决定了它可以进入的组别。 当有效组别尚未满足其标准时，我们会评估对非参考成员的每次替换，并选择能使 D ⁡ ( V ) D(V) 最大化的方案，但仅在平均值严格增加时才会接受该方案。 对于无效组别，替换项将根据其未通过检查的集合进行评估；当这些集合匹配时，会应用 AST Jaccard 检查。 参考项保持固定，且面板始终包含一个参考项、四个有效替代项和五个无效实现。 一旦两个标准均满足，或在评估完第三十个生成的补丁后，我们便会停止。 在该限制下，未完成面板且未同时满足两个标准的任务将被排除。 最终源配额将在符合条件的任务中进行选择；在此阶段未被选中的任务已通过质量筛选。 每个保留的工件必须与其记录的摘要相匹配。

sents.en: Generation and replacement.
sents.zh: 生成与替换。

sents.en: If either group fails its criterion, we continue generating candidates.
sents.zh: 如果任一组别未能满足其标准，我们将继续生成候选项。

sents.en: Each new candidate undergoes the same applicability, deduplication, and verifier checks.
sents.zh: 每个新候选项都会经过相同的适用性、去重和验证器检查。

sents.en: Its observed label determines the group it can enter.
sents.zh: 其观察到的标签决定了它可以进入的组别。

sents.en: When the valid group has not met its criterion, we evaluate each replacement of a nonreference member and choose the one that maximizes D ⁡ ( V ) D(V) , accepting it only if the mean strictly increases.
sents.zh: 当有效组别尚未满足其标准时，我们会评估对非参考成员的每次替换，并选择能使 D ⁡ ( V ) D(V) 最大化的方案，但仅在平均值严格增加时才会接受该方案。

sents.en: For the invalid group, replacements are assessed by their failed-check sets, with the AST Jaccard check applied when those sets match.
sents.zh: 对于无效组别，替换项将根据其未通过检查的集合进行评估；当这些集合匹配时，会应用 AST Jaccard 检查。

sents.en: The reference remains fixed, and the panel always contains one reference, four valid alternatives, and five invalid implementations.
sents.zh: 参考项保持固定，且面板始终包含一个参考项、四个有效替代项和五个无效实现。

sents.en: We stop as soon as both criteria hold or after evaluating the thirtieth generated patch.
sents.zh: 一旦两个标准均满足，或在评估完第三十个生成的补丁后，我们便会停止。

sents.en: At that limit, tasks without a complete panel satisfying both criteria are excluded.
sents.zh: 在该限制下，未完成面板且未同时满足两个标准的任务将被排除。

sents.en: Final source quotas select from the eligible tasks; tasks left unselected at this stage have passed the quality filters.
sents.zh: 最终源配额将在符合条件的任务中进行选择；在此阶段未被选中的任务已通过质量筛选。

sents.en: Every retained artifact must match its recorded digest.
sents.zh: 每个保留的工件必须与其记录的摘要相匹配。

paragraphs.en: It is zero when both rates are zero and undefined when either rate is undefined. We first round Valid Acceptance Rate and Invalid Rejection Rate to the two decimal places shown as percentages in the tables, compute their harmonic mean, and then round H H to two decimal places.
paragraphs.zh: 当两个比率均为零时，该值为零；当任一比率无定义时，该值也无定义。 我们首先将有效接受率和无效拒绝率四舍五入到表格中以百分比形式显示的小数点后两位，计算它们的调和平均值，然后将 H H 四舍五入到小数点后两位。

paragraphs.en: The harness recognizes errors such as a missing entry script or a timeout and otherwise uses the test runner’s exit status. A nonzero exit may reflect an assertion failure or another problem inside the script, so interpreting a candidate disagreement requires inspecting the test and source. This limitation also applies to a recorded failure on the initial state.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架能够识别缺失入口脚本或超时等错误，否则则使用测试运行程序的退出状态。 非零的退出状态可能表示断言失败或脚本内部的其他类似问题，因此要判断是否存在潜在的差异，需要检查测试代码和源代码。 这一限制同样适用于初始状态中记录到的失败情况。

paragraphs.en: For Entry Coverage, trusted tests identify production entry points with a unique, auditable mapping to local source spans in the reference state. The collector forms E i E_{i} from executable coordinates in those spans, using the union of executed and unexecuted coordinates in the generated tests’ reference state coverage report. Generated test execution on the reference state forms H i g H_{i}^{g} . Trusted tests fix the entry scope; its executable coordinates need not have been executed by trusted tests. Overlapping entry spans count each coordinate once, and the scope can extend beyond changed lines.
paragraphs.zh: 对于入口覆盖，可信测试会识别生产环境的入口点，并通过与参考状态中本地源代码跨度的一一对应关系实现唯一且可审计的映射。 收集器从这些跨度中的可执行坐标生成 E i E_{i}，使用的是生成测试在参考状态覆盖报告中所包含的执行和未执行坐标的并集。 在参考状态下执行生成的测试会形成 H i g H_{i}^{g}。 可信测试确定了入口范围；其可执行坐标未必已被可信测试执行过。 重叠的入口跨度中每个坐标仅计算一次，且该范围可能延伸至已更改代码行之外。

paragraphs.en: The stored f2p_rate field records the single reference success indicator F i F_{i} : initial failure and reference acceptance by the submitted entry script. paragraphs.en: The stored valid acceptance rate includes all five valid candidates, including the reference. The task rate A i A_{i} above covers the other four candidates for Valid Acceptance Rate. Invalid Rejection Rate measures rejection of the invalid candidates. Both metrics first compute each task’s rate from recorded outcomes, including recorded errors as unmatched, and then average the defined task rates with equal weight. This follows the task averaging convention of the stored run summaries. The stored valid acceptance rate retains the reference, so its task rate must be recomputed over the other four valid candidates before averaging to report Valid Acceptance Rate. The stored balanced patch accuracy is the arithmetic mean of the stored valid acceptance rate and invalid rejection rate. The mutation score aliases the stored invalid rejection rate, so it provides no additional independent observation.
paragraphs.zh: 已存储的有效接受率包含所有五个有效候选项，包括参考项。 上述任务率 A_i（A_{i}）涵盖了有效接受率的其他四个候选项。 无效拒绝率用于衡量对无效候选项的拒绝情况。 这两项指标首先根据记录的结果计算每个任务的比率，其中记录的错误被视为未匹配项，然后以相等权重对定义的任务比率求平均。 这遵循了已存储的运行摘要中的任务平均惯例。 已存储的有效接受率保留了参考项，因此其任务比率必须在求平均之前，基于其他四个有效候选项重新计算，才能报告有效接受率。 已存储的平衡补丁准确率是已存储的有效接受率与无效拒绝率的算术平均值。 突变分数与已存储的无效拒绝率同名，因此它并未提供任何额外的独立观察信息。

paragraphs.en: Joint Success Function averages the stored task resolution indicator over the fixed benchmark. A positive indicator requires initial failure, acceptance of every valid candidate, rejection of every invalid candidate, and no recorded execution error. Missing required outcomes receive no joint success credit.
paragraphs.zh: 联合成功函数在固定基准上对存储的任务解决指示器进行平均。 正向指示器需要初始失败、接受所有有效候选项、拒绝所有无效候选项，且没有记录的执行错误。 缺少必要结果的情况不会获得任何联合成功积分。

paragraphs.en: Evidence boundary. Generation uses the original public task and public source. Internal repairs are hypotheses used as execution controls. Review runs in a fresh copy of the original source with the generated tests; no generated source repair is installed there. The host supplies bounded execution symptoms and checks review citations against public evidence. Only tests are exported for benchmark scoring. Reference Acceptance Rate during training provides host feedback about the supplied reference; it does not expose the reference contents or the hidden evaluation panel to the test generator. This objective remains distinct from the final Joint Success Function metric.
paragraphs.zh: 证据边界。 生成过程使用原始公开任务和公开来源。 内部修复是用作执行控制的假设。 审查在原始来源的一个新副本中运行，其中包含生成的测试；没有安装任何生成的来源修复。 主机提供受限制的执行症状，并检查审查引用与公开证据的一致性。 仅导出测试用于基准评分。 训练期间的参考接受率为主机提供关于所提供参考的反馈；它不会向测试生成器暴露参考内容或隐藏的评价面板。 此目标与最终的联合成功函数指标保持区分。

paragraphs.en: Controlled optimization space. The fixed K = 3 K=3 comparison sets both candidate fields to three and excludes them from mutation. The remaining fields allocate the existing inference budget or change reusable guidance; the execution model and its weights, tool implementations, base skill library, execution validator, semantic review protocol, and total task budget stay fixed. Configuration validation imposes additional constraints: differential challenges require at least two rounds, cross execution, semantic review, and corrective feedback. A single proposal changes exactly one declared strategy field. A lesson proposal changes exactly one item while preserving all others. The host validates the schema and rejects embedded task identifiers and code blocks in learned prose; the reflection instructions additionally prohibit copying solutions or hidden patches. The optimizer therefore influences execution through bounded strategy decisions, while model interfaces and validation remain fixed. The effect of coupling between the optimizer and execution model on learned guidance is outside this study’s scope.
paragraphs.zh: 受控的优化空间。 固定的 K = 3 比较设置将两个候选字段均设为三，并将其排除在突变之外。 其余字段分配现有的推理预算或更改可重复使用的指导；执行模型及其权重、工具实现、基础技能库、执行验证器、语义审查协议和总任务预算保持不变。 配置验证施加了额外约束：差异挑战需要至少两轮，跨执行、语义审查和纠正性反馈。 单个提案仅更改一个已声明的策略字段。 课程提案仅更改一个项目，同时保留所有其他项目。 主机验证该模式，并拒绝嵌入在所学文本中的任务标识符和代码块；反思指令还禁止复制解决方案或隐藏补丁。 因此，优化器通过有限的策略决策影响执行，而模型接口和验证保持不变。 优化器与执行模型之间的耦合对所学习指导的影响超出了本研究范围。

paragraphs.en: Lessons and routing. A lesson contains an identifier, one to eight literal retrieval triggers, text of at most 1,000 characters, and optional component and capability tags. Explicit components are planning, preparation, generation, repair, and review. An update renders the text as applicability, action, and observable verification. Retrieval uses the public task, current phase, and host execution checkpoint; it selects at most two applicable lessons within 1,600 characters for an agent turn, or 1,200 for planning. The seven routing contexts are general, algorithm, framework, stateful, performance, CLI, and visual. Routes select from the fixed enabled skill library, and reviewer skills cannot be routed to candidate generation. An empty route list leaves specialist loading to the agent; it does not install a learned routing strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 课程与路由。 一个课程包含一个标识符、一到八个字面检索触发词、最多 1,000 个字符的文本，以及可选的组件和能力标签。 显式组件包括规划、准备、生成、修复和审查。 一次更新将文本呈现为适用性、行动和可观察验证。 检索使用公开任务、当前阶段和主机执行检查点；它为一个智能体回合选择最多两个适用课程，字符数不超过 1,600，规划时则不超过 1,200。 七种路由上下文分别是通用、算法、框架、状态保持、性能、CLI 和视觉。 路由从固定的已启用技能库中选择，且审查员技能不能被路由到候选生成。 空的路由列表会将专家加载留给智能体；它不会安装已学习的路由策略。

paragraphs.en: Data assignment. The 600 optimization tasks, supplied in the supporting materials, are partitioned into 500 proposal (training) tasks and 100 search development (validation) tasks. All task assignments use seed 42. The proposal tasks provide execution traces for diagnosis and strategy revision. Reference Acceptance Rate on the search development set ranks candidates and can inform subsequent search; it is consequently an optimization signal, not independent validation. Another 100 tasks from the remaining 1,100 in the 1,700 task training pool form a held-out optimization test set for release validation. These three sets and the benchmark test set are disjoint. The assignment changes neither the task pool nor the benchmark denominator.
paragraphs.zh: 数据分配。 支持材料中提供的 600 个优化任务被划分为 500 个提案（训练）任务和 100 个搜索开发（验证）任务。 所有任务分配均使用种子值 42。 提案任务提供执行轨迹，用于诊断和策略修订。 搜索开发集上的参考接受率用于对候选方案进行排序，并可为后续搜索提供指导；因此，它是一种优化信号，而非独立的验证。 在 1,700 个任务的训练池中，从剩余的 1,100 个任务中再抽取 100 个任务，组成一个预留的优化测试集，用于发布验证。 这三个集合与基准测试集互不重叠。 该分配方式既未改变任务池，也未改变基准测试的分母。

paragraphs.en: AutoSaddler adaptation. The AutoSaddler search uses Claude Opus 4.6 for candidate selection, diagnosis and revision, and subsequent reflection through three agent sessions. Opus 4.6 also executes TestHelix on the proposal and development tasks, yielding one strategy search with a fixed execution model. Its evolution DAG records parent relationships, edits, execution outcomes, and reusable lessons. We adapt AutoSaddler ( Park et al., 2026 ) to test generation by invoking the test generation runner in single-reference evaluation mode and mapping each completed task to the binary score above. The adaptation constrains proposals to the strategy schema in Appendix C , checks the changed field, and rejects changes to the evaluator, tools, task inputs, or inference caps.
paragraphs.zh: AutoSaddler 适配。 AutoSaddler 搜索使用 Claude Opus 4.6 进行候选选择、诊断与修订，并通过三轮智能体会话进行后续反思。 Opus 4.6 还在提案与开发任务上执行 TestHelix，从而生成一个具有固定执行模型的策略搜索。 其演化 DAG 记录了父节点关系、编辑操作、执行结果以及可复用的经验教训。 我们通过在单参考评估模式下调用测试生成运行器，并将每个完成的任务映射到上述二元评分，来适配 AutoSaddler（Park et al., 2026）以测试生成能力。 该适配将提案限制为附录 C 中的策略方案，检查已更改的字段，并拒绝对评估器、工具、任务输入或推理上限的任何修改。

paragraphs.en: Optimizer configuration. The corresponding AutoSaddler configuration uses train_minibatch_size=25 , train_eval_attempts=1 , train_epochs=1 , completed_train_iterations=20 , and max_candidate_proposals=40 . Both capability_phase_iterations and capability_phase_epochs are zero; skip_session0 , monotonic_full_train_gate , the adapter’s monotonic_train_gate , and use_merge are false. Selection, mutation, and reflection have separate session timeouts. Optimizer calls, tokens, failures, and elapsed time are separate resource quantities from the generator’s inference cap.

paragraphs.en: Initial strategy. The initial strategy eagerly requests three candidates and keeps both candidate count fields fixed at three throughout optimization. It uses two rounds, 12 agent steps, five repair steps, an 18,000 token context limit, a 10,000 character tool output limit, and a 2,048 token review output limit. Cross execution, semantic review, and corrective feedback are enabled, with one differential challenge step and an execution positive fallback. The 12 curated skills remain fixed; guidance, lessons, and skill routes initially are empty. These settings instantiate the initial strategy.

paragraphs.en: Each proposal changes one of the nine mutable fields; a lesson update changes one lesson while preserving the rest. The six scalar ranges in Table 12 define the scalar search space. Guidance, lessons, and routes obey the schema bounds and evidence restrictions documented in Appendix C . The lower bound of two rounds preserves the differential challenge configuration. Increasing a component limit does not increase the shared task cap: all generation, review, repair, and feedback calls consume the same allowance. Provider reported usage is used when available; otherwise accounting retains conservative reservations. The task’s public runtime limit also applies. For an official agent limit T T , the bridge reserves min ⁡ ( 120 , T / 4 ) \min(120,T/4) seconds for cleanup and another 20 seconds before passing a runtime cap to the Node process. The profile cannot override that cap: the runner’s default T = 600 T=600 seconds yields a 460 second Node limit despite the 900 second profile setting. The test execution limit is likewise the smaller of 180 seconds and the task’s public test timeout. All compared strategies retain the same task deadlines. Execution repeats verify a suite’s behavior and do not grant extra independent test generation attempts. The fixed prompts appear in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 每个提案都会更改九个可变字段中的某一个；课程更新会更改一个课程，同时保留其余部分。 表 12 中的六个标量范围定义了标量搜索空间。 指导、课程和路线均遵循附录 C 中记录的方案边界和证据限制。 两轮的 нижняя граница 保留了差异挑战配置。 提高某个组件的限额并不会增加共享任务的上限：所有生成、审查、修复和反馈调用都消耗相同的配额。 如果可用，则使用提供商报告的用量；否则，会计系统会保留保守的预留量。 该任务的公开运行时限制同样适用。 对于官方智能体限额 T T，桥接器会为清理预留 min ⁡ ( 120 , T / 4 ) \min(120,T/4) 秒，并在将运行时上限传递给 Node 进程前再预留 20 秒。 配置文件不能覆盖该上限：运行程序的默认值 T = 600 T=600 秒会导致 Node 的限额为 460 秒，尽管配置文件中设置了 900 秒。 测试执行限额同样取 180 秒与任务公开测试超时时间中的较小值。 所有被比较的策略都保留相同的任务截止日期。 重复执行用于验证整个套件的行为，并不会提供额外的独立测试生成尝试。 固定提示词见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Each completed round evaluates a parent on 25 previously unused proposal tasks, produces a revision, and evaluates the child afresh on those same tasks. The screen requires a strict increase in successful initial-to-reference transitions and zero regressions among previously successful tasks. Only a child satisfying both conditions receives evaluation on the 100 search development tasks. The initial strategy receives the same development evaluation once. AutoSaddler selects the strategy with the highest Reference Acceptance Rate on the development set under Opus 4.6 and freezes it before release validation. After this search, the RSI configuration in Table 3 uses the same frozen strategy with GPT 5.6 sol and Kimi K3. Neither benchmark model supplies feedback for strategy optimization, and the strategy is not adapted to either model during benchmark evaluation. A development score need not increase for a candidate to be evaluated or retained in the search history.
paragraphs.zh: 每轮完成时，系统会用此前未使用过的 25 个提案任务对父智能体进行评估，生成一次修订，然后重新用这些相同任务对子智能体进行评估。 该界面要求初始状态到参考状态的顺利转换必须严格增加，且此前已成功的任务中不得出现任何倒退。 只有同时满足这两个条件的子智能体，才会获得 100 个搜索开发任务的评估。 初始策略会接受一次相同的开发评估。 AutoSaddler 会在 Opus 4.6 环境下选择开发集上参考接受率最高的策略，并在发布验证前将其锁定。 此次搜索结束后，表 3 中的 RSI 配置将使用相同的锁定策略，搭配 GPT 5.6 sol 和 Kimi K3。 两种基准模型都不会为策略优化提供反馈，且策略在基准评估期间也不会针对任一模型进行调整。 候选智能体的开发得分无需提升，即可被评估或保留在搜索历史中。

paragraphs.en: The release validation protocol compares exactly one frozen challenger with the initial strategy on the separate 100 release validation tasks, using Opus 4.6 to execute both strategies. The promotion rule requires a positive paired difference in Reference Acceptance Rate and a one sided exact McNemar p ≤ 0.05 p\leq 0.05 , with the direction fixed before evaluation. For w w challenger only successes and ℓ \ell initial only successes, the test uses the upper binomial tail at w w conditional on w + ℓ w+\ell discordant pairs, with probability 1 / 2 1/2 under the null. With no discordant pairs, there is no evidence for promotion. The protocol reports both discordant counts, both success counts, and 95% and 99% paired bootstrap intervals from 10,000 task resamples using seed 42. Each resample keeps the two outcomes for a task together.
paragraphs.zh: 发布验证协议将唯一的一个冻结挑战者与初始策略在独立的 100 个发布验证任务上进行精确比较，并使用 Opus 4.6 执行两种策略。 升级规则要求参考接受率存在正向配对差异，且单侧精确 McNemar p 值 ≤ 0.05（p\leq 0.05），其中方向在评估前已固定。 对于仅 w 个挑战者成功和仅 ℓ 个初始成功的案例，该测试使用二项分布的上尾概率，条件为 w + ℓ 个不一致配对，在零假设下概率为 1/2（1/2）。 若无不一致配对，则无升级证据。 该协议报告了两种不一致计数、两种成功计数，以及基于 10,000 次任务重采样（使用种子 42）得到的 95% 和 99% 配对自助置信区间。 每次重采样都会保留一个任务的两种结果。

paragraphs.en: Independent validation results. Table 13 reports the paired comparison on the 100 release validation tasks. Reference Acceptance Rate increases from 48% to 58%, a gain of 10 percentage points. Both strategies succeed on 46 tasks and fail on 40; the remaining 14 tasks comprise 12 new successes and two regressions. The positive gain and one sided exact McNemar p = 0.006470 p=0.006470 satisfy the release criterion for the frozen strategy.

paragraphs.en: Native baselines use the latest harness releases available by August 15, 2026, except for ZCode as specified below. They have no experiment-imposed inference budget cap and retain the public task execution limits. They do not share the TestHelix inference caps; budget matching applies to the five TestHelix configurations in RQ4. The cutoff releases are Claude Code 2.1.233 , Kimi Code CLI 0.36.1 , Qwen Code 0.21.12 , Codex CLI 0.147.0 , DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6 , and Terminus-2 bundled with Harbor 0.21.0 . These are the latest stable releases by the cutoff, except for DeepSeek Harness, whose available release is a release candidate. ZCode uses the August 28, 2026 release. Except for the explicitly labeled -low configuration, we use the highest supported reasoning setting: max for Claude, Kimi K3, GPT 5.6 sol, DeepSeek, and GLM; xhigh for Qwen3.8 Max and GPT 5.4. Kimi K2.7 Code uses mandatory thinking, and Qwen3.7 Plus uses thinking mode without an additional thinking-token cap.
paragraphs.zh: 原生基线模型使用截至 2026 年 8 月 15 日可用的最新工具版本，ZCode 除外（如下文所述）。 它们没有实验强加的推理预算上限，并保留公开任务执行限制。 它们不共享 TestHelix 的推理上限；预算匹配适用于 RQ4 中的五种 TestHelix 配置。 截止版本包括 Claude Code 2.1.233、Kimi Code CLI 0.36.1、Qwen Code 0.21.12、Codex CLI 0.147.0、DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6，以及与 Harbor 0.21.0 捆绑的 Terminus-2。 这些是截止日之前的最新稳定版本，但 DeepSeek Harness 的可用版本是一个候选发布版。 ZCode 使用 2026 年 8 月 28 日的版本。 除了明确标记为 -low 的配置外，我们使用最高支持的推理设置：Claude、Kimi K3、GPT 5.6 sol、DeepSeek 和 GLM 使用 max；Qwen3.8 Max 和 GPT 5.4 使用 xhigh。 Kimi K2.7 Code 强制启用思考模式，而 Qwen3.7 Plus 使用思考模式且没有额外的思考令牌上限。
