paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows Joint Success Function and candidate diversity. The score equally weights the six configurations in Table 2 on the same 50 tasks randomly sampled from the 300 benchmark tasks using seed 42. We use the same candidate generation and verifier validation procedure to expand each task’s standard ten implementation panel to 15 implementations: the reference, seven additional valid alternatives, and seven invalid candidates. These additions leave the panels used in the baseline and TestHelix comparisons unchanged. The submitted tests and the 50 task subset remain fixed while candidate sets grow under three addition schedules. The valid and invalid sets in the joint criterion are the selected diagnostic candidate sets, with the same labeling and verdict requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 图3展示了联合成功函数和候选多样性。 该评分对表2中的六种配置给予同等权重，这些配置基于使用种子42从300个基准任务中随机抽取的相同50个任务进行评估。 我们采用相同的候选生成和验证器验证流程，将每个任务的标准化十项实现面板扩展至15项实现：包括参考实现、七个额外的有效替代方案以及七个无效候选方案。 这些新增项并未改变基线对比和TestHelix对比中使用的实现面板。 提交的测试集和这50个任务子集保持不变，而候选集则按照三种不同的扩展方案逐步扩大。 联合标准中的有效集和无效集即为选定的诊断候选集，其标签和判定要求保持一致。

paragraphs.en: At k = 1 k=1 , the empty product is one and the metric equals the six configurations’ mean Reference Acceptance Rate, denoted Reference Acceptance Rate ¯ \overline{\text{Reference Acceptance Rate}} . Each additional required verdict can only preserve or remove success, so expected Joint Success Function is nonincreasing along each schedule. Within the expanded fifteen implementation panels, for 0 ≤ a ≤ 7 0\leq a\leq 7 and 0 ≤ b ≤ 7 0\leq b\leq 7 , Reference Acceptance Rate ¯ = Joint Success Function ¯ ​ ( 0 , 0 ) ≥ Joint Success Function ¯ ​ ( a , b ) ≥ Joint Success Function ¯ ​ ( 7 , 7 ) \overline{\text{Reference Acceptance Rate}}=\overline{\text{Joint Success Function}}(0,0)\geq\overline{\text{Joint Success Function}}(a,b)\geq\overline{\text{Joint Success Function}}(7,7) . Mean Reference Acceptance Rate is therefore the upper bound under the weakest criterion, and the full diagnostic panel gives the lower bound among its subsets. This ordering does not establish a universal bound on test quality or isolate the effect of candidate diversity selection.
paragraphs.zh: 当 k = 1 时，空积为 1，且该指标等于六个配置的平均参考接受率，记作 Reference Acceptance Rate ¯ \overline{\text{Reference Acceptance Rate}}。 每个额外要求的裁决只能维持或消除成功状态，因此期望联合成功函数沿每个调度都是非递增的。 在扩展后的十五个实施面板中，对于 0 ≤ a ≤ 7 和 0 ≤ b ≤ 7，有 Reference Acceptance Rate ¯ = Joint Success Function ¯ ​ ( 0 , 0 ) ≥ Joint Success Function ¯ ​ ( a , b ) ≥ Joint Success Function ¯ ​ ( 7 , 7 )。 因此，平均参考接受率是在最弱标准下的上限，而完整的诊断面板则给出了其子集中的下限。 这种排序并未确立对测试质量的通用界限，也未分离出候选多样性选择的影响。

paragraphs.en: Mean Joint Success Function starts at 49.33% and reaches 38.10% after five valid additions, 30.49% after five invalid additions, and 24.33% after nine alternating additions. The complete pool endpoints are 37.33%, 29.33%, and 23.33% for the valid, invalid, and alternating schedules. Complete pools include all admitted candidates; comparisons at different panel sizes impose distinct verdict requirements.

paragraphs.en: All 50 tasks remain in each configuration’s denominator. Missing or erroneous required outcomes receive no success credit, following the main evaluation protocol. Consequently, a decrease can reflect either a candidate disagreement or an additional missing or erroneous required observation.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 50 项任务都保留在每种配置的分母中。 根据主要评估协议，缺失或错误的必要结果将不会获得成功积分。 因此，减少可能反映候选者之间的分歧，或者存在额外的缺失或错误的必要观察结果。

paragraphs.en: Across the fourteen baselines in Tables 2 and 14 , Reference Acceptance Rate exceeds Joint Success Function by 15.33 to 36.00 percentage points: 53.07% to 74.58% of reference successes fail the joint criterion. In Table 2 , Claude Fable 5.1 leads both Reference Acceptance Rate and Joint Success Function, yet achieves joint success on only 84 of its 179 reference successes. Qwen3.7 Plus has the highest Valid Acceptance Rate at 81.00% but the lowest Invalid Rejection Rate at 48.67%; GLM 5.2 has the highest Invalid Rejection Rate at 90.33% but a Valid Acceptance Rate of 44.33%. Their Joint Success Function values are only 19.67% and 10.00%, respectively. Strong acceptance or rejection alone therefore does not establish reliable discrimination across the panel. These aggregate rates describe different behavioral profiles; they do not identify the overlap of valid and invalid candidate failures within reference successes. RQ1 relates coverage to reference and joint success.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 2 和表 14 中的十四条基准线中，参考接受率比联合成功函数高出 15.33 至 36.00 个百分点：参考成功案例中有 53.07% 至 74.58% 未能通过联合标准。 在表 2 中，Claude Fable 5.1 在参考接受率和联合成功函数方面均领先，但其 179 个参考成功案例中仅有 84 个实现了联合成功。 Qwen3.7 Plus 的有效接受率最高，为 81.00%，但无效拒绝率最低，仅为 48.67%；GLM 5.2 的无效拒绝率最高，为 90.33%，但其有效接受率仅为 44.33%。 它们的联合成功函数值分别为 19.67% 和 10.00%。 因此，仅凭较强的接受或拒绝能力，无法在整个评估组中建立可靠的区分能力。 这些汇总比率描述了不同的行为特征；它们并未揭示参考成功案例中有效与无效候选失败的交集。 RQ1 将覆盖范围与参考成功和联合成功联系起来。

paragraphs.en: A failed trajectory has task-level joint success indicator S i = 0 S_{i}=0 under the evaluation protocol. Using seed 42, we sample 50 such trajectories from the configuration with the highest Joint Success Function in each of six model families (Table 2 ), yielding 300 trajectories. Excluding 14 timeouts leaves 286 for expert annotation and analysis. Each observation comprises a task, model configuration, submitted test suite, and evaluation attempt. The reported proportions use these 286 trajectories as their denominator: 99 coverage gaps (34.6%), 143 faulty checks (50.0%), and 44 execution logic errors (15.4%).

paragraphs.en: The examples illustrate the mechanism definitions in Figure 4 (b) and the behavior of individual test submissions. Disputed candidate labels do not become evidence of an erroneous generated test solely because the generated verdict disagrees with trusted tests.

paragraphs.en: Two experts independently annotate all 286 retained trajectories using the seven error subtypes defined below. They inspect task requirements, submitted test suites, initial and reference executions, candidate outcomes, and supporting patch evidence. Cohen’s κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81 is computed from these independent subtype labels before adjudication. For each disagreement, a third expert joins both experts in discussion to determine the final label. We aggregate the final labels into the three parent categories reported in Section 4.3 and Figure 4 (b).
paragraphs.zh: 两名专家独立使用下文定义的七种错误子类型，对全部 286 条保留轨迹进行标注。 他们检查任务要求、提交的测试套件、初始执行与参考执行、候选结果以及支持性补丁证据。 在裁决前，根据这些独立的子类型标签计算得出 Cohen’s κ = 0.81 \kappa=0.81。 对于每一项分歧，第三位专家将加入两位专家的讨论，以确定最终标签。 我们将最终标签汇总至第 4.3 节和图 4 (b) 中报告的三个父类别。

paragraphs.en: Missing Inputs concerns omitted inputs, states, configurations, or combinations within an exercised operation. Untested Requirements concerns entire required behaviors or entry points without acceptance checks.
paragraphs.zh: 缺失输入涉及在执行操作中被遗漏的输入、状态、配置或组合。 未测试的需求涉及整个所需行为或没有验收检查的入口点。

sents.zh: 缺失输入涉及在执行操作中被遗漏的输入、状态、配置或组合。

sents.en: Untested Requirements concerns entire required behaviors or entry points without acceptance checks.
sents.zh: 未测试的需求涉及整个所需行为或没有验收检查的入口点。

paragraphs.en: Weak Checks and Wrong Criteria distinguish insufficient checks from incorrect or unsupported behavioral criteria. Overfitting enforces incidental implementation details beyond the task contract.
paragraphs.zh: 弱检查与错误标准能够区分不充分检查与不正确或无依据的行为标准。 过拟合会强制引入超出任务契约的偶然实现细节。

paragraphs.en: Fixture & API Errors concern errors in constructing test fixtures or using APIs within the test process. Command & Parsing Errors concern errors in the test’s command execution or output collection and parsing. External installation, network, and container failures remain infrastructure issues. Incorrect expectations about candidate behavior belong to Faulty Checks.
paragraphs.zh: 测试环境与 API 错误涉及在构建测试环境或在测试过程中使用 API 时出现的错误。 命令与解析错误涉及测试中的命令执行、输出收集及解析过程中出现的错误。 外部安装、网络和容器故障仍属于基础设施问题。 对候选行为的不正确预期属于检查错误。

sents.en: Fixture & API Errors concern errors in constructing test fixtures or using APIs within the test process.
sents.zh: 测试环境与 API 错误涉及在构建测试环境或在测试过程中使用 API 时出现的错误。

sents.en: Command & Parsing Errors concern errors in the test’s command execution or output collection and parsing.
sents.zh: 命令与解析错误涉及测试中的命令执行、输出收集及解析过程中出现的错误。

sents.en: External installation, network, and container failures remain infrastructure issues.
sents.zh: 外部安装、网络和容器故障仍属于基础设施问题。

sents.en: Incorrect expectations about candidate behavior belong to Faulty Checks.
sents.zh: 对候选行为的不正确预期属于检查错误。

paragraphs.en: A direct single reference blind spot requires the same submitted suite to fail on the initial program, pass on the reference, and accept a candidate whose contract violation is supported by local evidence. Missing Inputs and Weak Checks provide examples of this pattern: the same suite passes the reference while accepting an invalid alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 直接单一引用盲点要求：同一套提交的测试用例在初始程序中失败，在参考程序中通过，并且接受一个其合同违反行为有局部证据支持的候选项。 缺失输入和弱检查提供了这种模式的例子：同一套测试用例通过了参考程序，却接受了一个无效的替代方案。

sents.en: A direct single reference blind spot requires the same submitted suite to fail on the initial program, pass on the reference, and accept a candidate whose contract violation is supported by local evidence.
sents.zh: 直接单一引用盲点要求：同一套提交的测试用例在初始程序中失败，在参考程序中通过，并且接受一个其合同违反行为有局部证据支持的候选项。

sents.en: Missing Inputs and Weak Checks provide examples of this pattern: the same suite passes the reference while accepting an invalid alternative.
sents.zh: 缺失输入和弱检查提供了这种模式的例子：同一套测试用例通过了参考程序，却接受了一个无效的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Reference failures caused by execution logic errors or other mechanisms cannot explain a decline conditional on reference success without additional paired evidence. Trusted candidate labels guide witness selection but do not establish correctness for every input. These observations identify mechanisms consistent with the aggregate evaluation gaps; they do not establish causal attribution for aggregate model scores or estimate the prevalence of each mechanism across the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 由执行逻辑错误或其他机制引起的参考失败，无法在没有额外配对证据的情况下解释以参考成功为条件的性能下降。 可信的候选标签可以指导见证的选择，但并不能确保每个输入的正确性。 这些观察结果识别出与总体评估差距一致的机制；但它们并未确定模型总分的原因归属，也未估计每种机制在整个基准测试中的出现频率。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 includes native agent comparators for each model. The baseline comparison appears in Tables 2 and 14 . The following protocol defines five TestHelix configurations, denoted A through E in table order. The first four use the initial test generation strategy; the fifth uses a strategy improved through Recursive Self Improvement (RSI), with three test and repair pairs. Strategies remain frozen during benchmark evaluation. Here K K counts internal test and repair pairs, independently of the hidden evaluation panel size.
paragraphs.zh: 表3包含了每个模型的原生智能体比较器。 基线比较出现在表2和表14中。 以下协议定义了五种TestHelix配置，在表中按顺序用A到E表示。 前四种使用初始的测试生成策略；第五种则使用通过递归自我改进（RSI）优化的策略，包含三对测试与修复。 在基准评估期间，策略保持固定不变。 此处K K统计内部测试与修复对的数量，与隐藏的评估面板大小无关。

sents.en: Table 3 includes native agent comparators for each model.
sents.zh: 表3包含了每个模型的原生智能体比较器。

sents.en: The baseline comparison appears in Tables 2 and 14 .
sents.zh: 基线比较出现在表2和表14中。

sents.en: The following protocol defines five TestHelix configurations, denoted A through E in table order.
sents.zh: 以下协议定义了五种TestHelix配置，在表中按顺序用A到E表示。

sents.en: The first four use the initial test generation strategy; the fifth uses a strategy improved through Recursive Self Improvement (RSI), with three test and repair pairs.
sents.zh: 前四种使用初始的测试生成策略；第五种则使用通过递归自我改进（RSI）优化的策略，包含三对测试与修复。

sents.en: Strategies remain frozen during benchmark evaluation.
sents.zh: 在基准评估期间，策略保持固定不变。

sents.en: Here K K counts internal test and repair pairs, independently of the hidden evaluation panel size.
sents.zh: 此处K K统计内部测试与修复对的数量，与隐藏的评估面板大小无关。

paragraphs.en: Single. Configuration A uses one test and repair pair ( K = 1 K=1 ), with initial state checks, an own repair control, and self correction. Its suite qualifies locally when it reproducibly fails on the initial state and passes on its own repair. Peer Cross Validation is disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 单一。 配置 A 使用一个测试与修复对（K = 1 K=1），包含初始状态检查、专属修复控制以及自我修正功能。 当该套件在初始状态下可重复地失败，但在自身修复中通过测试时，即被视为本地合格。 同伴交叉验证已禁用。

sents.en: Single.
sents.zh: 单一。

sents.en: Configuration A uses one test and repair pair ( K = 1 K=1 ), with initial state checks, an own repair control, and self correction.
sents.zh: 配置 A 使用一个测试与修复对（K = 1 K=1），包含初始状态检查、专属修复控制以及自我修正功能。

sents.en: Its suite qualifies locally when it reproducibly fails on the initial state and passes on its own repair.
sents.zh: 当该套件在初始状态下可重复地失败，但在自身修复中通过测试时，即被视为本地合格。

sents.en: Peer Cross Validation is disabled.
sents.zh: 同伴交叉验证已禁用。

paragraphs.en: Heterogeneous Synthesis with random submission. Configuration B uses Heterogeneous Synthesis to develop three pairs ( K = 3 K=3 ) with distinct synthesis directions. Each pair is developed independently using local execution checks for self correction. Cross execution, independent semantic review, corrective feedback, and suite merging remain disabled. After local correction, one suite is selected uniformly at random from the locally qualified pairs, using seed 42 fixed before evaluation. This configuration never enters peer cross validation, and selection uses no hidden evaluation outcomes. A task with no qualified suite remains in the evaluation set and receives no success credit; it is not replaced or resampled.
paragraphs.zh: 随机提交的异构合成。 配置 B 使用异构合成为三个不同的合成方向开发三对（K = 3 K=3）。 每对都通过本地执行检查进行自我纠正，且独立开发。 跨执行、独立的语义审查、纠正性反馈和套件合并仍处于禁用状态。 本地纠正后，从本地合格的套件对中均匀随机选择一个套件，并在评估前固定使用种子 42。 此配置绝不会进入同侪交叉验证，且选择过程不使用任何隐藏的评估结果。 没有合格套件的任务将保留在评估集中且不会获得成功积分；该任务不会被替换或重新采样。

sents.en: Heterogeneous Synthesis with random submission.
sents.zh: 随机提交的异构合成。

sents.en: Configuration B uses Heterogeneous Synthesis to develop three pairs ( K = 3 K=3 ) with distinct synthesis directions.
sents.zh: 配置 B 使用异构合成为三个不同的合成方向开发三对（K = 3 K=3）。

sents.en: Each pair is developed independently using local execution checks for self correction.
sents.zh: 每对都通过本地执行检查进行自我纠正，且独立开发。

sents.en: Cross execution, independent semantic review, corrective feedback, and suite merging remain disabled.
sents.zh: 跨执行、独立的语义审查、纠正性反馈和套件合并仍处于禁用状态。

sents.en: After local correction, one suite is selected uniformly at random from the locally qualified pairs, using seed 42 fixed before evaluation.
sents.zh: 本地纠正后，从本地合格的套件对中均匀随机选择一个套件，并在评估前固定使用种子 42。

sents.en: This configuration never enters peer cross validation, and selection uses no hidden evaluation outcomes.
sents.zh: 此配置绝不会进入同侪交叉验证，且选择过程不使用任何隐藏的评估结果。

sents.en: A task with no qualified suite remains in the evaluation set and receives no success credit; it is not replaced or resampled.
sents.zh: 没有合格套件的任务将保留在评估集中且不会获得成功积分；该任务不会被替换或重新采样。

paragraphs.en: Peer Cross Validation. Configuration C retains three pairs and combines the cross execution, semantic review, and corrective feedback operations in Section 3 . Peer repairs qualify as witnesses through local consistency checks, with distinct lineage and source content preventing duplicate support. Independent review interprets the task, original source, tests, and bounded execution symptoms without seeing generated repairs. Reviewed peer counterexamples guide correction. When distinct qualified repairs pass the existing suites and both suites pass review, differential challenges search for missing behavioral distinctions. Revised suites undergo fresh execution and review. Selection uses witness support, and compatible suites with common passing witnesses may be merged. The B to C comparison evaluates this complete feedback process, including its selection and merging rules.
paragraphs.zh: 同伴交叉验证。 配置 C 保留三对，并结合了第 3 节中的交叉执行、语义审查和纠正反馈操作。 同伴修复通过局部一致性检查成为见证者，其独立的谱系和源内容可防止重复支持。 独立审查会解读任务、原始源、测试和有界执行症状，但不会看到已生成的修复。 经过审查的同伴反例会引导纠正。 当不同的合格修复通过现有测试套件且两个套件都通过审查时，差异挑战将寻找缺失的行为区别。 修订后的套件会进行新的执行和审查。 选择过程会使用见证支持，具有共同通过见证的兼容套件可以合并。 B 到 C 的比较评估了这一完整的反馈流程，包括其选择和合并规则。

sents.zh: 同伴交叉验证。

paragraphs.en: Pair count. Configuration D uses five pairs ( K = 5 K=5 ) with the same peer cross validation process and initial strategy as C. The C to D comparison varies pair count under the same total inference limit. Five pairs appear only in this comparison, without additional random submission or RSI configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 配对数量。 配置 D 使用五对（K = 5 K=5），并采用与 C 相同的同伴交叉验证流程和初始策略。 C 与 D 的比较在于，在相同总推理限制下，二者的配对数量不同。 五对仅出现在此比较中，且没有额外的随机提交或 RSI 配置。

sents.zh: 配对数量。

sents.zh: 配置 D 使用五对（K = 5 K=5），并采用与 C 相同的同伴交叉验证流程和初始策略。

paragraphs.en: RSI. Configuration E uses peer cross validation with three pairs and one improved, frozen test generation strategy. AutoSaddler uses Opus 4.6 for both strategy revision and task execution during optimization; GPT 5.6 sol and Kimi K3 then share the selected strategy for benchmark evaluation without further adaptation. Both initialCandidates and maxCandidates are fixed at three throughout strategy search, validation, and benchmark evaluation. The remaining guidance and allocation fields can evolve within the same total budget. The RSI increment compares E with C, which uses the initial strategy at the same pair count. The frozen strategy passes the independent Opus 4.6 release validation in Appendix C.3.5 . Benchmark tasks and their hidden panels do not enter strategy updates.
paragraphs.zh: RSI。 配置 E 使用同伴交叉验证，包含三对数据以及一种改进的、冻结的测试生成策略。 AutoSaddler 在优化过程中同时使用 Opus 4.6 进行策略修订和任务执行；随后 GPT 5.6 sol 和 Kimi K3 共享所选策略以进行基准评估，无需进一步调整。 在整个策略搜索、验证和基准评估过程中，initialCandidates 和 maxCandidates 均固定为三。 其余的引导和分配字段可以在相同的总预算范围内演化。 RSI 增量将 E 与 C 进行比较，其中 C 在相同对数下使用初始策略。 该冻结策略通过了附录 C.3.5 中独立的 Opus 4.6 发布验证。 基准任务及其隐藏面板不会进入策略更新流程。

sents.en: RSI.
sents.zh: RSI。

paragraphs.en: Shared controls and submission. Within each model group, all five configurations use the same base model, public task access, evaluator, tools, base skill library, and total inference limits. Strategy search uses training tasks and a disjoint validation gate; both task sets exclude the final benchmark. Learned allocations remain subject to the same total inference limits as the initial strategy. The budget is shared across pairs rather than multiplied by K K ; all requested pairs begin in the initial round. The run configuration comprises the planning settings, execution repetitions, random seed, pair count, and strategy. Disabling feedback excludes it from generation and selection, including cached evidence and prompts. Configurations A and B require local consistency for submission. Configurations C, D, and E also require semantic approval; if no common peer witness is available, an approved suite with reproducible initial failure and a passing own repair remains eligible. Internal qualification does not provide success credit in the hidden benchmark evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 共享控制与提交。 在每个模型组中，所有五种配置均使用相同的基模型、公共任务访问权限、评估器、工具、基础技能库和总推理限制。 策略搜索使用训练任务和独立的验证关卡；这两组任务均不包含最终基准测试。 学习到的分配仍然受到与初始策略相同的总推理限制。 预算在成对之间共享，而不是乘以 K；所有请求的配对都从初始轮次开始。 运行配置包括规划设置、执行重复次数、随机种子、配对数量和策略。 禁用反馈会将其排除在生成和选择之外，包括缓存证据和提示。 配置 A 和 B 要求提交时保持本地一致性。 配置 C、D 和 E 还需要语义批准；如果无法找到共同的同行见证，则一个经过批准的套件（具有可重现的初始失败和通过自身修复的能力）仍然符合资格。 内部资格认证不会在隐藏基准测试评估中提供成功积分。

sents.en: Configurations A and B require local consistency for submission.

sents.en: Configurations C, D, and E also require semantic approval; if no common peer witness is available, an approved suite with reproducible initial failure and a passing own repair remains eligible.

sents.en: Internal qualification does not provide success credit in the hidden benchmark evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Reporting and interpretation. All 300 tasks remain in the Reference Acceptance Rate and Joint Success Function denominators. Valid Acceptance Rate measures acceptance of the four valid alternatives, excluding the reference. This rate and Invalid Rejection Rate use the observed candidate denominator within each task and average the defined task rates with equal weight. Coverage uses observed, nonempty measurement denominators; missing coverage is not zero. Within each model group, all five configurations use the same benchmark task set. These configurations share inference limits. Inference consumption includes every role, retry, and correction call; strategy development and benchmark inference are distinct accounting scopes. Equal limits do not imply equal consumed compute.
paragraphs.zh: 报告与解释。 所有 300 项任务均保留在参考接受率与联合成功函数的分母中。 有效接受率衡量对四个有效替代方案的接受情况，不包括参考方案。 该比率与无效拒绝率使用每项任务中观察到的候选者分母，并以相等权重对定义的任务比率进行平均。 覆盖率使用观察到的非空测量分母；缺失的覆盖率并非零。 在每个模型组内，所有五种配置均使用相同的基准任务集。 这些配置共享推理限制。 推理消耗包括每个角色、重试和纠正调用；策略开发与基准推理属于不同的核算范围。 相等的限制并不意味着消耗的算力相等。

sents.zh: 推理消耗包括每个角色、重试和纠正调用；策略开发与基准推理属于不同的核算范围。

sents.en: Equal limits do not imply equal consumed compute.
sents.zh: 相等的限制并不意味着消耗的算力相等。

paragraphs.en: The A to B comparison evaluates the complete Heterogeneous Synthesis design, which expands both the number of independently developed test and repair pairs and the range of exploration directions. Guided by the branch prompts, the LLM determines concrete task-specific directions, including complementary behaviors and corner cases. Additional pairs provide space to pursue these directions within the same total inference cap. This comparison therefore measures the overall benefit of heterogeneous expansion relative to Single. The B to C comparison evaluates the complete peer cross validation process, including cross execution, semantic review, and corrective feedback. The C to D comparison measures pair count under a fixed budget, and the C to E comparison measures RSI at fixed K = 3 K=3 . The RSI increment is therefore relative to the three pair peer cross validation configuration, not the adjacent five pair row.
paragraphs.zh: A到B的比较评估了完整的异构合成设计，该设计既增加了独立开发的测试与修复对的数量，也扩大了探索方向的范围。 在分支提示的指导下，LLM确定具体的任务特定方向，包括互补行为和边缘情况。 额外的对数在同一总推理上限内为追求这些方向提供了空间。 因此，这种比较衡量了异构扩展相对于单一体制的总体收益。 B到C的比较评估了完整的同侪交叉验证过程，包括交叉执行、语义审查和纠正性反馈。 C到D的比较在固定预算下衡量了对数，而C到E的比较则在固定K = 3时衡量RSI。 因此，RSI的增量是相对于三个对的同侪交叉验证配置而言的，而不是相邻的五个对行。

paragraphs.en: Reliable test generation spans a broad space of task specifications, inputs, implementations, and execution environments. This study focuses on one part of that problem: whether tests written by coding agents distinguish valid and invalid implementations under fixed task contracts. TestPrism evaluates ten labeled implementations per task, and Joint Success Function measures joint success within these finite candidate patch sets. The comparisons concern complete deployed agent configurations, while the TestHelix ablations examine component contributions within each model group. The taxonomy complements these results by characterizing recurring failure mechanisms in 286 analyzed failed trajectories, after excluding 14 timeouts from 300 trajectories sampled equally from the highest Joint Success Function configuration in each of six model families. Failed trajectories have a per-task joint success indicator of zero. The category proportions describe the retained sample and exclude the timeout trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的测试生成涵盖了任务规范、输入、实现和执行环境的广泛空间。 本研究聚焦于该问题的一部分：由编码智能体编写的测试是否能在固定任务契约下区分有效与无效的实现。 TestPrism 对每个任务的十种带标签的实现进行评估，而联合成功函数则衡量这些有限候选补丁集合内的联合成功情况。 这些比较涉及完整的部署智能体配置，而 TestHelix 的消融分析则考察每个模型组内各组件的贡献。 该分类体系通过描述在 286 条被分析的失败轨迹中反复出现的失败机制，从而补充了上述结果；这些轨迹是从六个模型族中联合成功函数最高的配置均匀采样出的 300 条轨迹中排除 14 条超时轨迹后得到的。 失败轨迹的每个任务的联合成功指标为零。 各类别比例描述了保留的样本，且未包含超时轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Source gold tests. We select established public benchmarks with documented test validation, including the widely adopted SWE bench and Terminal Bench families (Appendix B.3.1 ). Their original quality controls provide the foundation for task and verifier quality. Building on this foundation, our second-stage validation checks adapted verifiers through execution and independent expert review for requirement alignment and potential reference overfitting; tasks with unresolved concerns are excluded. Our scope is evaluating generated tests across implementations under these validated task contracts. Independently re-establishing the correctness of each upstream benchmark is outside this study.
paragraphs.zh: 源黄金测试。 我们选择经过验证的公开基准，这些基准具有文档记录，包括广泛采用的 SWE bench 和 Terminal Bench 系列（附录 B.3.1）。 其原有的质量控制为任务和验证器的质量提供了基础。 在此基础上，我们的第二阶段验证通过执行和独立专家审查来检查适配后的验证器，以确保其与需求一致并避免潜在的参考过拟合；存在未解决疑虑的任务将被排除。 我们的研究范围是在这些经过验证的任务合同下，评估跨不同实现的生成测试。 独立地重新确立每个上游基准的正确性不属于本研究范围。

sents.en: Source gold tests.
sents.zh: 源黄金测试。

paragraphs.en: Panel composition and diversity. The prevalence of valid and invalid human patches is difficult to establish and can vary across tasks and development settings. Our equal allocation provides a balanced evaluation design without estimating this prevalence. The diversity contributed by a candidate also depends on task semantics, implementation choices, defect patterns, and its relationship to candidates already in the panel. Consequently, a valid to invalid ratio alone does not determine diversity, and equal counts do not guarantee equal difficulty for acceptance and rejection. Our admission checks use mean AST distance for the valid group and failed-check sets with conditional AST filtering for the invalid group. They do not establish exhaustive semantic coverage or an optimal candidate set. Jaccard distance summarizes overlap in the chosen AST feature representation and can differ from semantic distance; its mean over a panel need not increase with every added patch. This work introduces Joint Success Function and candidate patch sets with explicit diversity controls. Optimizing the label ratio, panel size, or candidate selection is outside its scope.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体组合与多样性。 有效和无效人类补丁的普遍性难以确定，且可能因任务和开发设置而异。 我们的均等分配无需估计这种普遍性，即可提供均衡的评估设计。 候选智能体所贡献的多样性还取决于任务语义、实现选择、缺陷模式以及其与面板中已有候选智能体的关系。 因此，仅凭有效与无效的比例无法决定多样性，而数量均等也不保证接受和拒绝的难度相同。 我们的准入检查对有效组使用平均 AST 距离，对无效组则使用失败检查集合并配合条件 AST 过滤。 它们并未建立全面的语义覆盖或最优的候选智能体集合。 Jaccard 距离总结了所选 AST 特征表示中的重叠部分，可能与语义距离不同；其在一个面板上的平均值未必会随着每个新增补丁而增加。 本研究引入了联合成功函数以及具有明确多样性控制的候选补丁集合。 优化标签比例、面板规模或候选智能体选择不在其研究范围之外。

paragraphs.en: Extending evaluation to evolving specifications, broader implementation spaces, and additional execution environments remains a direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 将评估扩展到不断演变的规范、更广泛的实现空间以及额外的执行环境，仍然是未来工作的一个方向。
